Even if I work like an ox or a horse, I can never repay your kindness..."

Three days ago, her son had gone to Qingzhou with Physician Si to receive treatment. If it weren’t for Madam Xie acting as an intermediary, they would never have met Physician Si in their lifetime.

With Physician Si’s help, her son’s life would definitely be saved. She could then die content, able to tell the ancestors of the Wu family that their family line had not been broken!

Yun Chu helped Wu Madam up, "Since I bought the Wu family’s ancestral villa, helping Young Master Wu with his treatment was just a small matter. Wu Madam, please don’t say such things. You’re embarrassing me."

Wu Madam wanted to say more, but a servant boy whispered something in Chen Defu’s ear. Chen Defu’s expression suddenly changed, "Madam, Concubine He’s identity has been found out!"

---

chapters.title: Tao Concubine’s Premature Birth
chapters.content:
One month ago, He Xu was forced to leave the capital due to debt. Since then, Yun Chu had arranged for someone to follow him.

"The servant reported in a low voice, 'After He Xu left the capital, he went straight towards Jizhou. His hometown is not in Jizhou but in Yangliu Village, more than thirty li outside Jizhou City. When I arrived at the village, I found out that He Xu’s original name was He Xu, and his original surname was He. Chen Bo had me inquire about a woman named He Lingcheng, but there were no families with the surname He in the village. In a moment of desperation, I replaced He with He and found out that there was indeed a woman named He Lingcheng, who was He Xu’s younger sister.'"

Yun Chu’s hand paused.

No wonder she couldn’t find any information about the He family in the entire capital. It turned out that the surname was He.

"I went to the village head for information. As soon as I mentioned the He family, the village head’s expression turned secretive. He smoked his pipe without saying a word. I gave the village head some silver, but he closed the door and refused to talk to me anymore... I stayed in Jizhou for half a month and became familiar with the old women in the village before I found out a little. The He family moved to the village more than twenty years ago. They were all elderly, women, and children under the age of seven. Everyone had injuries, and it was a tragic sight. In the first month after moving to the village, seven or eight people from the He family died of illness..."

"The younger generation of the He family, that is, He Xu’s generation, died until only he and his sister, He Lingcheng, remained. The entire clan pooled their resources to find He Lingcheng a good husband, but I was unable to find out which family she married into."

Chen Defu’s expression was one of great shock, "Madam, wasn’t there a prominent family with the surname He in the capital that was destroyed more than twenty years ago? Could it be..."

More than twenty years ago, Yun Chu had not yet been born, but she had heard her family members mention this incident.

At that time, the head of the He family, He Daren, served as the Minister of Revenue. That year, there was a severe drought, and seven or eight provinces in the south were affected. The court allocated two hundred thousand taels of silver for disaster relief, but when this money reached the south, less than twenty thousand taels remained... Countless disaster victims starved to death or died of thirst. Countless people were displaced, and a large number of commoners gathered, leading to uprisings... The consequences were very serious.

After the matter was settled, the court thoroughly investigated the disaster relief funds. The investigation revealed that the Ministry of Revenue was riddled with corruption from top to bottom.

As the Minister of Revenue, although He Daren was not directly involved in embezzlement, he had accepted favors from those who were, creating a united front that completely deceived the Emperor.

The court was shaken, and the Emperor was furious. The more they investigated, the worse it became. All males in the He family within the third degree of kinship, above the age of seven, were sentenced to beheading. Women and children under the age of seven were imprisoned for half a year. When they were finally released, only about thirty people remained from the once large family. The court then sent them back to their original hometown.

On the way to Yangliu Village in Jizhou, more than ten people died, leaving only about twenty when they arrived at their destination.

And even after arriving, life was not easy, which was why only He Xu and his sister, He Lingcheng, survived from the youngest generation.

Yun Chu’s lips curled into a cold smile, "So our Madam, Concubine He, is the daughter of a criminal."

He Shi’s father was a minor official in the Ministry of Revenue, and her grandfather was the Minister of Revenue. More than twenty years ago, the He family was at the peak of their glory.

Once the incident occurred, the entire family collapsed... She finally understood why Xie Shian had such strong opinions against the current Emperor. With so many family members dying at the Emperor’s hands, He Shi’s resentment towards the court and the Emperor would naturally influence her usual teachings, which was why Xie Shian, at such a young age, already harbored hatred for the Emperor...

Chen Defu was greatly frightened, "If the master took a woman from the He family as a concubine, and if someone with ill intentions finds out, I’m afraid..."

Although the court did not exile the women and young children of the He family, nor did it explicitly prohibit them from leaving their hometown, the descendants of criminals were still considered half-criminals. It was one thing to wander around a thousand miles away, but to come all the way to the capital and marry an official, if someone with ill intentions reported this to the Censorate, the censor could impeach the Xie family, and that would be enough to bring them down.

Yun Chu shook her head.

Even if He Lingcheng, a weak woman, married an official, it wouldn’t be seen as a threat by the court. The price Xie Jingyu would pay would be nothing more than a demotion.

But if the descendants of the He family, one married a prince, and another entered the Imperial College...

The He family had a feud with the imperial family, yet they went to great lengths to get close to them. What would the Emperor think?

If this matter was well-planned, it could bring down the entire Xie family.

What needed to be done now was to make He Lingcheng no longer just Concubine He, but the birth mother of the Xie family’s eldest young master, second young master, and eldest young lady.

Leaving the villa, they returned to the Xie residence.

Yun Chu went straight to Xie Jingyu’s courtyard. This was his study, and after their marriage, he had always stayed here.

When she arrived, the maids were somewhat surprised because, during this period, Yun Chu had never set foot in this courtyard.

"You may all leave."

Yun Chu spoke, and the maids quickly nodded and left in an orderly manner.

The study was filled with books, and on the desk, there was a half-written memorial by Xie Jingyu. Yun Chu picked it up and glanced at it, finding nothing unusual.

She searched around and, in the gap between a few books, found an account book.

She took out the account book. The elegant handwriting was clearly that of a woman:

"In the spring of the 13th year of Shuntian, Yuquan, gave birth to the eldest young lady. Midwife fee: 5 taels."

"In the autumn of the 15th year of Shuntian, Yuquan, gave birth to the eldest young master. Midwife fee: 7 taels."

"In the autumn of the 18th year of Shuntian, Jizhou, gave birth to the second young master..."

The Xie family’s old residence was in Yuquan, Jizhou. Xie Jingyu moved to Jizhou after passing the imperial examinations, and later came to the capital after becoming a Jinshi... These times all matched up.

And this handwriting, with a slight comparison, it was clear that it was He Lingcheng’s.

Yun Chu smiled. Xie Jingyu truly did not guard against her at all. He had placed such an important item so casually on the bookshelf.

She put the account book into her sleeve.

At this moment, Tingshuang’s voice came from outside, "Greetings to the master."

Xie Jingyu’s brows furrowed, "Why are you here?"

Tingshuang lowered her head, "Madam came to speak with the master. Seeing that the master was not here, she went in to rest for a moment."

As she spoke, the door opened.

Yun Chu stood behind the door, her gaze falling on Xie Jingyu’s hand, "What is this in my husband’s hand?"

Xie Jingyu lifted the gift box, "This is a ginseng root given by Minister Hu."

He raised his other hand, "This is tea leaves given by Minister Zhou."

Yun Chu curled her lips.

It seemed that after becoming the future father-in-law of the Prince of Anjing, Xie Jingyu’s days were gradually improving.

"What did you come to discuss with me, madam?"

Xie Jingyu placed the gift box on the desk and looked at Yun Chu.

"During the morning greetings, Concubine Ting came to me in tears, wanting to take Yun Ge back." Yun Chu spoke, "It seems Yun Ge is also ill. What does my husband think?"

Xie Jingyu frowned, "Since Yun Ge has been given to Concubine He, she will raise him. If he’s ill, we can call a doctor."

"I think the same." Yun Chu smiled, "Speaking of which, Concubine He and our Xie family have some fate. This morning, Concubine Tao even said that Concubine He and Bing Jie look exactly alike. If someone who doesn’t know the situation sees them, they might think Concubine He is Bing Jie’s birth mother."

Hearing these words, Xie Jingyu was completely stunned, as if his heart had fallen into an ice cellar.

He should have realized long ago that as a daughter grows, she will resemble her mother more and more. The more Bing Jie grew, the more she would look like He Shi’s face...

chapters.title: Who is More Vicious
chapters.content:
Yun Chu had just left the study when Xie Jingyu immediately went to Bihe Garden, the courtyard where He Shi resided.

He Shi was doing embroidery when she saw Xie Jingyu approaching. She stood up in disbelief, "Why has the master come here?"

Ever since she became a concubine of the Xie family, the master had never set foot in her courtyard. She didn’t dare to expect anything more.

Having never harbored any expectations, she naturally felt surprised.

She quickly served tea and respectfully handed it to Xie Jingyu.

Xie Jingyu took the tea and drank a sip, his eyes fixed on He Shi.

He had met He Shi when he was only sixteen. Back then, she still bore the surname He.

Now, he was twenty-eight, and she was the same age. However, over the years, she had given birth and raised children, later entering the Xie household as a maid, toiling day and night. Additionally, she deliberately wore dull-colored clothes to make herself appear at least thirty-five years old.

If she were to change into lighter colors like pale pink or goose yellow, adorn herself with some jewelry, and apply makeup, she would look exactly like her daughter, Pin Jie.

He Shi felt uneasy under his gaze, "Master?"

Xie Jingyu spoke, "Have you noticed that Pin Jie looks more and more like you?"

He Shi's fingers stiffened, "Master, I have already done my best to conceal it."

She wore the ugliest clothes, never dressed up, and apart from a single silver hairpin, she never wore any other jewelry.

Even though she was neglected by the master, she didn’t dare to dress up and flaunt herself to compete for favor... for fear that people would realize she was Pin Jie’s biological mother.

"From now on, apart from paying your daily respects, stay in your courtyard and don’t go out." Xie Jingyu stood up, "Speaking of Yun Ge, he’s been ill. Where is he?"

He Shi’s expression froze.

Had the master come here just to see Yun Ge?

She suppressed a bitter smile and led Xie Jingyu into the side room. She gently pushed open the door. Xie Shiyun was asleep on the couch.

At the slightest noise, Xie Shiyun woke up. Seeing Xie Jingyu enter, he paid no heed to anything else, rolling off the couch and grabbing Xie Jingyu’s sleeve, crying, "Father, I want to return to Concubine’s side."

Xie Jingyu helped him up, "Your Concubine has made a mistake. Once she corrects it, I will let her come and take you back."

He Shi let out a sigh of relief.

Yun Ge was being raised in her courtyard, and all his allowances were also sent to Bihe Garden. She was already tight on money, but with Yun Ge’s monthly allowance, many problems could be solved.

"Yun Ge, stop crying." He Shi stepped forward, "Once you are better, I will take you to see Concubine Yu."

Xie Shiyun started wailing. If his father didn’t agree, who else could he ask?

He was already sick, and soon, he cried himself to sleep.

"He Shi, Yun Ge is just a bit restless because he caught a cold. He’s fine." He Shi spoke, "It’s almost dinner time. Master, why not stay and dine at Bihe Garden?"

Xie Jingyu’s expression was cold, "No need."

He strode out of Bihe Garden.

Soon, the little maid at the entrance returned to report, "Concubine, the master has gone to Concubine Yu’s courtyard."

He Shi clenched her fingers tightly and took out a piece of silver, throwing it to the little maid, "Keep watching. Come and inform me again when the master leaves."

The little maid took the silver, delighted, and went off to do as told.

"Seems I really underestimated you."

He Shi’s face darkened.

She had thought the master was busy, so he didn’t stay to dine with her. She hadn’t expected him to immediately go to that little vixen Tingyu’s courtyard.

She glanced at the side room where Xie Shiyun was staying. Remembering what Concubine Tao had said behind her back, that she and Pin Jie looked alike, a thought quietly arose in her heart.

Tingyu’s courtyard was small and remote, with the only advantage being a separate small kitchen.

She had prepared some delicious and exquisite dishes, intentionally sending a maid to invite Xie Jingyu over. Unexpectedly, he came with just one invitation.

Over the years, she had felt guilty towards the madam and never dared to use her culinary skills to compete for favor. Now, for the sake of Yun Ge, she had to use every trick in the book.

"Master, try this sweet and sour radish."

Tingyu stood by the dining table, attending to Xie Jingyu as he ate.

Xie Jingyu was not a man of strong desires, whether in physical or culinary matters; he kept them within reasonable limits.

But the recent hot weather had killed his appetite. Knowing Tingyu was a good cook, he followed the little maid over. Indeed, a table full of delicacies stimulated his appetite, and he finished a whole bowl of rice in one go.

After the meal, it was already dark. Tingyu placed her hand on Xie Jingyu’s shoulder, "Master, you’ve had a long day. Let me take good care of you."

Xie Jingyu’s expression was indifferent, "I know exactly what you have in mind."

Wasn’t it just to beg him to relent and let Yun Ge return?

Tingyu’s face stiffened. She lowered her head, "Master, I just want to see more of Yun Ge. Please, give me a chance."

Xie Jingyu considered himself a qualified father. Earlier, when he saw Xie Shiyun, he had softened a little.

How could a three-year-old child be separated from his birth mother?

He spoke, "If you behave yourself, sooner or later, Yun Ge will naturally return to your courtyard."

Hearing this, Tingyu was overjoyed. She attended to Xie Jingyu with even more devotion.

Xie Jingyu was thriving in his career outside and enjoying the affection of his concubines at night. For a moment, he felt like sighing, "Life is worth living."

That night, Tingyu also felt deeply content.

At some unknown hour, there was a sudden sound of a maid knocking at the door.

Tingyu opened her eyes and looked out the window. The sky was still dark.

She quickly draped her clothes around herself and went out, scolding in a low voice, "Can’t you see the master is still resting? Why are you knocking? Don’t you have any sense?"

The master had finally taken a day off, and she wanted him to rest more. When he woke up later, he could have the five-grain congee she had prepared to nourish his stomach.

"Concubine, something bad has happened!" The little maid was almost in tears, "Concubine Tao is about to give birth!"

Tingyu frowned.

According to the due date, Concubine Tao should still have a month before giving birth. Why was she going into labor so soon?

But perhaps it was because Concubine Tao’s sharp tongue had caught up with her, she hadn’t accumulated enough virtue, causing the child to be premature. Served her right.

She softly said, "If Concubine Tao is giving birth, just inform the madam. She will arrange everything. The master is a man; there’s nothing he can do to help."

The little maid urgently said, "Concubine Tao went into early labor because the Third Young Master pushed her and made her fall. She’s lost a lot of blood!"

"What did you say?" Tingyu’s face immediately fell, "Yun Ge is just a child. How could he possibly push Concubine Tao and make her fall? Who would make a three-year-old child take the blame? No, I must go and see!"

At this moment, Xie Jingyu inside the room was woken up by the noise. His voice came out, "What happened?"

Tingyu quickly turned back, "Master, the maid said Concubine Tao was pushed by Yun Ge and fell, causing her early labor. But Yun Ge lives in Bihe Garden, which is far from Concubine Tao’s residence. Moreover, Yun Ge is still sick. How could he do such a ridiculous thing? Master, please go and see for yourself and clear Yun Ge’s name!"

Xie Jingyu immediately got up.

A woman going into early labor was no small matter.

He still remembered that years ago, Yun Chu had also fallen and gone into early labor, losing a lot of blood...

---

chapters.title: Is the Child Alive?
chapters.content:
The sky was just beginning to lighten.

Concubine Tao’s courtyard was in chaos. Maids continuously carried in hot water and then carried out basins of blood-red water.

From inside the room came Concubine Tao’s harrowing screams of pain. The midwife instructed her on how to push, but she just couldn’t deliver...

Yun Chu stood in the courtyard, her expression somewhat grave.

After He Shi had schemed against Concubine Tao last time, she had thought that the child in Concubine Tao’s womb was lucky and would be carried to term safely.

She hadn’t expected the second scheme to come so quickly. Moreover, in her previous life, the Xie family’s second young master had been born on this very day, also at dawn.

Even though the current situation was vastly different from her past life, did that mean the events that were supposed to happen would still occur?

She suppressed her emotions and looked at He Shi, who stood before her with her head lowered, and at Xie Shiyun, whom He Shi was holding by the hand. She coldly said, "Concubine He, what exactly happened? Explain yourself!"

"He Shi replied to the madam, these past few days, Yun Ge has been ill and couldn’t sleep well. So, I let him sleep with me. Who would have thought that at the Yin hour, he suddenly started making a fuss, insisting on going to see Concubine Yu." He Shi said with her head lowered, "The sky wasn’t even bright yet. How could I let a child go out alone? I coaxed him to sleep a little longer, but he bit me..."

As she spoke, she revealed a bite mark on her arm for Yun Chu to see, then continued, "After he bit me, he ran out. I followed him. Maybe because it was still dark, Yun Ge couldn’t tell the directions and ended up running into Concubine Tao’s courtyard. At that time, the servants were changing shifts, and there was no one at the courtyard entrance. Yun Ge just charged in. By the time I followed him inside, I saw Concubine Tao had fallen from the steps of the house to the ground, and Yun Ge was standing there, looking terrified..."

"Madam, it’s all my fault. I didn’t take good care of Yun Ge, causing Concubine Tao to go into early labor!"

He Shi wore a self-reproaching expression.

At this moment, Xie Jingyu and Tingyu arrived.

Tingyu rushed to Xie Shiyun’s side in one swift motion, crouched down, and hugged her son, "Yun Ge, quickly tell Madam and Master that you didn’t push Concubine Tao. Speak up!"

Xie Shiyun stood there dumbfounded, unable to say a word.

"If you won’t speak, then I can only assume it was you." Xie Jingyu’s expression was stern, "At just three years old, you dare to do such a thing?"

Tingyu quickly stepped in front of Xie Shiyun, "Master, Yun Ge has always been timid. When I took care of him, he wouldn’t even dare to step on an ant. How could he, in Concubine He’s courtyard, turn into someone like this? I don’t believe Yun Ge would do such a thing. Please, Master, investigate thoroughly and clear Yun Ge’s name!"

Xie Jingyu was about to speak when a voice came from inside the house, "It’s born! It’s born! The child is born, it’s a boy!"

Xie Jingyu’s heart relaxed slightly, but then his brows furrowed, "Why don’t I hear the child crying?"

Before his eyes flashed the scene of Yun Chu’s childbirth years ago, also premature, also basins of bloody water being carried out, also a child born without a cry...

Yun Chu showed little emotion on her face.

Sure enough, just like in her past life, after a while, the sound of the child crying could be heard, though it was a bit weak.

"Amitabha, it’s good that the child is fine!" The old madam and Yuan Shi had also arrived. Both had joyful expressions, "It’s a boy. Our Xie family has another addition. How wonderful."

Yun Chu shook her head.

This child was born weak. At six months old, he still couldn’t lift his head. At two or three years old, he still couldn’t speak, dull and slow. Eventually, he was despised by the old madam...

The old madam was happy for a while, but then she noticed Xie Shiyun standing there. Her anger surged, "Jingyu, Yun Ge’s courage is too great. If it weren’t for Concubine Tao’s strong body, it could have been two lives lost. Tell me, how should this matter be handled?"

Xie Jingyu rubbed his fingers together and looked at Yun Chu, "Madam, what do you think?"

Yun Chu calmly said, "Perhaps we should wait until Concubine Tao has recovered a bit, and then I can ask her what exactly happened."

At this moment, the midwife came out carrying the child. It was a fair and clean little boy, his eyes closed as he lay wrapped in swaddling clothes.

Xie Jingyu glanced at him and then looked away. Yuan Shi, however, lovingly held him in her arms for a long time before handing him to the wet nurse.

Yun Chu did not hold the child. She stepped into the delivery room to check on Concubine Tao’s condition.

"Concubine Yu, you must ask Yun Ge exactly what happened!" Xie Jingyu said coldly, "Concubine He, come with me!"

He Shi pressed her lips together and followed Xie Jingyu into a side room.

As soon as they entered, Xie Jingyu’s expression darkened, "He Lingyuan, tell me, was it you?"

He Shi heard her birth name and for a moment, she felt a sense of disorientation. It seemed like a lifetime ago when they had met, fallen in love...

"Yu Lang, it wasn’t me." She stammered, "An Ge is already grown up and accomplished. I have no reason to do this..."

"If it wasn’t you, then who else could it be!" Xie Jingyu’s eyes burned with anger, "A month ago, your scheme failed, so you came up with another one. This time, you even used a child like Yun Ge! If I didn’t know you so well, I would never have suspected you. With this scheme, you wanted to kill the unborn child and also make me so angry that I would send Yun Ge away. Then, there would be no one in the Xie family who could threaten An Ge’s position, right?"

He had almost believed He Shi’s words and thought it was really Yun Ge who had pushed Concubine Tao.

But upon second thought, Yun Ge was only three years old and still sick. Early in the morning, before dawn, no child, no matter how unruly, would run around like that.

It must have been He Shi who said something to Yun Ge.

"I truly didn’t expect you to have such methods!" Xie Jingyu narrowed his eyes, "Years ago, when Yun Chu fell and went into early labor, was that also your doing? I really misjudged you!"

After Yun Chu became pregnant, he had brought He Shi into the Xie family, making her a manager maid in his courtyard.

After Yun Chu’s children were stillborn and she lost the ability to bear children, he then took the opportunity to bring all three children from outside into the household.

At the time, everything had seemed to go too smoothly. Now, looking back, that smoothness was perhaps too terrifying.

Although he despised the two children in Yun Chu’s womb for not being of Xie blood, he had never considered scheming to cause a miscarriage or stillbirth...

He saw He Shi’s face change, as if a bolt of lightning had struck him.

He had never told He Shi that those two children were not his. How dare she lay a hand on the main wife of the household...

If she could harm Yun Chu, then repeatedly targeting Concubine Tao seemed acceptable as well...

"Master, why are you looking at me like that? Do you think I’m vicious?" He Shi laughed, "You overestimate me. There are so many loyal maids around the madam. How would I have the chance? On the contrary, it was you, years ago, who personally threw the two newborn children, still breathing, into the snow. How are you any better than me?"

Xie Jingyu’s heart jolted violently.

"An unborn child doesn’t count as a life. No matter what I do, I haven’t taken a life." He Shi enunciated each word, "Those two children still had Xie blood in them. Yet, you threw them into the freezing snow... I know you did this for the sake of having the madam devote herself entirely to raising An Ge and the others. I know you did it for An Ge’s good. So, I have kept this secret in my heart all along. Even if the madam had tortured me severely, I never revealed a single word..."

chapters.title: The Xie Family is Cursed
chapters.content:
Yun Chu stepped out of the delivery room.

She had intended to find Xie Jingyu to tell him what Aunt Tao had said, but after taking a few steps, she faintly heard something from before the New Year.

She immediately made a gesture, signaling the two maids beside her to tread lightly.

She moved quietly but swiftly, reaching the side room’s door.

The voices inside were not very clear, but she could piece together fragments into a sentence.

"...children still breathing... first thrown away..."

"...those two children are of Xie blood..."

"...thrown into the ice and snow..."

A thunderous roar echoed in her mind as blood rushed to her head, nearly making her collapse.

Listening to the voices, Ling Shuang and Ling Feng naturally heard them too. Their pupils contracted sharply, unable to believe what they had heard.

Ling Feng, impatient by nature, reached out to push the door open.

Ling Shuang grabbed Ling Feng’s arm, steadying Yun Chu. Her voice was extremely low, trembling: "Madam?"

Yun Chu’s legs were so weak she could barely stand, clutching Ling Shuang’s hand tightly.

She knew that even if they barged in now, Xie Jingyu and He Shi could just claim she had misheard.

They would never admit to such a thing...

Yun Chu made a gesture, and Ling Shuang and Ling Feng supported her as they left the courtyard and returned to Shengju.

After helping her into the inner chamber and lying down on the couch, Ling Shuang and Ling Feng knelt down with a thud. Ling Xue, not understanding, followed suit.

"Slap! Slap! Slap!"

Ling Shuang fiercely slapped herself several times.

"Madam, it’s all this slave’s fault. During the New Year, when you were giving birth, I shouldn’t have handed the young master and young miss to the people in the master’s courtyard. I truly didn’t know the young master and young miss were still alive. Madam, this slave was wrong. Please strike me dead..."

Ling Feng also began slapping herself, crying: "Madam, this slave deserves ten thousand deaths. It’s my fault... I’ll go ask the master now. How could he be so heartless? How could he throw his own flesh and blood into the snow? Oh heavens, those tiny children; how could they have survived?"

Ling Xue, realizing the situation, widened her eyes in disbelief.

So the two young masters and misses Madam had given birth to before the New Year were still alive at the time?

That night, Madam had been walking in the courtyard when she somehow slipped. That night, she began to have abdominal pains, and then went into premature labor.

Madam’s lower body had been bleeding nonstop, so much blood... All the maids had been terrified. Ling Shuang had held Madam’s hand, speaking to her, while Ling Feng had crouched at the foot of the bed, cleaning up for Madam. What had she been doing? Oh yes, she had been feeding Madam chicken soup to give her strength to deliver the children...

Madam had labored from night until dawn. Finally, the children were born, but they did not cry.

She remembered the midwife had wrapped the children and then exclaimed that they had no breath. That single sentence had caused Madam to hemorrhage, a life-threatening postpartum complication... With two children without breath and Madam’s life hanging by a thread, they hadn’t had to make a choice. Ling Shuang had quickly ordered the midwife to take the children away...

After the children were taken away, Madam had lost consciousness...

When Madam had woken up again, three days had passed. By then, the children had already been buried. Madam had been silent for days, and they had not dared to mention the children again... Later, the young master, second young master, and young miss had entered the household. Then, Aunt Yu had given birth. The third young master was about the same age as the two deceased young masters and misses, so he had been placed in Madam’s care, and Madam had slowly recovered...

The sound of repeated slaps snapped Yun Chu back to her senses.

"Stop!"

She spoke heavily.

She had considered countless possibilities, but never once had she thought that the children might have been born alive...

Even though they were premature, even though they hadn’t cried at birth, even though their breathing had been weak, they had been alive. If she had taken good care of them, surely they could have survived... But Xie Jingyu had thrown them away!

If they had been thrown out in the middle of summer, there might have been a slim chance of survival.

But she had given birth during a snowstorm. It had been so cold. How could two newborns have survived in such conditions?

So the children hadn’t died at birth; they had been abandoned by their own father, left outside to perhaps freeze or starve to death.

All so that she would devote herself entirely to raising his children with He Shi!

He was simply a beast!

No, calling him a beast was an insult to beasts!

Yun Chu closed her eyes, forcing the tears back.

Right now, she only wanted to know one thing: where had the children been abandoned? No matter what, she had to find them, whether they were alive or dead...

Xie Jingyu was the epitome of hypocrisy. From his mouth would only come one lie after another, just like the unknown skeletal remains that had been reburied.

"Ling Feng, go to the outskirts of the city now." Yun Chu spoke each word deliberately. "Bring back some thunder god vine yourself."

Ling Shuang froze. Even though she had no knowledge of medicine, she knew what thunder god vine was. When combined with certain other herbs, it could be used to dispel wind, but if used improperly, it could cause discomfort, or, in simpler terms, it was a poison.

"Yes, Madam!" Ling Feng scrambled up from the floor, wiped her tears, and hurried out.

How could the master still live so carefree when Madam’s own flesh and blood had died? How could Madam suffer so much while the Xie family prospered?

The master deserved to swallow this poison and rot from the inside out!

Yun Chu spent the entire night in a daze, not knowing if she had slept or not. Various scenes flashed through her mind like a carousel, and before she knew it, she heard the crowing of the rooster.

She got up early to practice martial arts.

Autumn Tong, though unaware of the specifics, could sense her unease and suggested she rest for the day.

Yun Chu shook her head.

If she practiced for two days and then rested for three, what could she possibly learn?

After practicing for more than half an hour, the sky gradually brightened. She returned to her room to wash up and change clothes before coming out. Those who had come to pay their respects had already arrived.

Aunt Tao, having just given birth, had not come. Ling Yu had dark circles under her eyes. He Shi was holding a listless-looking Xie Shiyou. Jiang Shi lowered her head, holding the usually quiet Xie Xian.

The matter of Aunt Tao being pushed and falling the day before had been personally investigated by Xie Jingyu, who had declared it an accident and dropped the matter.

Yun Chu sneered. He Shi had used such a huge secret to threaten Xie Jingyu. That weak man naturally wouldn’t dare to punish He Shi, so he had to smooth things over.

"If there’s nothing else, you may all withdraw." She lifted her gaze. "Aunt Yu, stay behind."

He Shi blocked Ling Yu’s line of sight toward Xie Shiyou and led the child out.

She deeply regretted it. She had gone to great lengths to stage yesterday’s incident, but not only had she failed to kill the child in Aunt Tao’s womb, she had also failed to get Xie Shiyou punished. Instead, she had completely ruined the affection between her and the master.

Ling Yu remained alone in the hall, feeling uneasy and lowering her head, not daring to say anything.

Yun Chu spoke: "Last night, I had someone investigate the matter of Aunt Tao’s premature birth."

Ling Yu quickly said, "Madam, the master said it was just an accident. It has nothing to do with Young Master You."

"Indeed, it has nothing to do with Young Master You." Yun Chu set down her teacup. "According to the people in my courtyard, it was Aunt He who told Young Master You that the child in Aunt Tao’s womb would be raised by me. That’s what drove Young Master You to go to Aunt Tao’s courtyard early in the morning and do such a thing..."

Ling Yu suddenly lifted her head.

---

chapters.title: The Master Performs a Ritual
chapters.content:
After the morning greetings, Yun Chu went to Aunt Tao’s courtyard.

Aunt Tao was young, and even though she had given birth prematurely, it hadn’t affected her health. She was already able to sit up and hold the child herself.

Upon seeing Yun Chu enter, she immediately handed the child to the wet nurse. With a face full of grief, she said, "Madam, you must seek justice for me! I was pushed by the third young master, which caused me to fall and go into premature labor. Madam, look at this, how small the child is. I don’t even know if it will survive. It’s all the third young master’s fault! But the master actually called it an accident and didn’t punish the third young master. How can I swallow this bitterness?"

Yun Chu walked over and glanced at the child sleeping in the swaddling clothes.

This child, born a month premature, was already so small. Her own pair of children, born nearly two months early, would have been even smaller...

This child had barely survived. If it grew up, it might be slow-witted... If her own children had miraculously survived, she couldn’t imagine what kind of life they would have...

At the thought, Yun Chu’s nose felt a sting of sorrow.

She suppressed her emotions and sat down on the chair by the bed. "Aunt Tao, do you truly believe that a child not even four years old would be so malicious as to intentionally push you into premature labor?"

Aunt Tao keenly detected the deeper meaning in her words and hastily asked, "This concubine is foolish. Madam, please speak more clearly."

Yun Chu shook her head. "Someone tried to harm you once and failed, so they naturally tried again. Young Master You was merely used. The master saw this clearly, which is why he wouldn’t punish Young Master You. And that person is the master’s beloved, so naturally, he has to protect her."

Aunt Tao’s eyes widened suddenly.

A month ago, she had been schemed against by Aunt He and had nearly miscarried... So this time, it was also Aunt He’s doing?

If that wretched woman He Shi continued to stay in the Xie family, her premature son would never survive to adulthood!

"I can’t do anything with the master protecting her." Yun Chu stood up. "You should rest well and take good care of your child. In the future, just avoid her."

With that, she left the room.

Aunt Tao’s face darkened like water.

She just didn’t understand, how could the master care so much for that old woman He Shi? Even his own flesh and blood had nearly died, yet he still protected that wretched woman!

What she understood even less was that if He Shi was trying to pave the way for her future children, shouldn’t the first target be the eldest young master, who had already passed the imperial examinations?

Wait, she and Jiang Shi had discussed this before. The young miss resembled He Shi, and the young miss and the eldest young master were siblings from the same mother. Could it be that the eldest young master was truly He Shi’s son?

But if the master had such a big child before marriage, how had the Yun family not found out?

Regardless of the truth, He Shi could not be allowed to stay in the Xie family any longer. Otherwise, there would be a third attempt on her life...

Aunt Tao pressed her lips together and said to the attending maid, "Go and ask Aunt Yu to come over. Tell her I want to ask about how to raise a child."

Yun Chu returned to Shengju.

As she entered the room, she saw Ling Feng cleaning the thunder god vine she had brought back, carefully laying it out on the windowsill to dry.

This was the great gift she had prepared for Xie Jingyu.

Let this poison slowly corrode Xie Jingyu’s internal organs, let him gradually lose control of his body, let him watch as the Xie family falls, and let him go to hell.

She truly wished she could stab Xie Jingyu to death with a single blade... A man who wouldn’t even spare his own flesh and blood deserved to be condemned to eternal damnation!

"Madam." Ling Shuang entered and said in a low voice, "This slave has investigated everyone in the residence. On the night before you buried the young master and young miss, the eldest young master went to a village near that hill. That night, a couple moved away in the middle of the night. Upon inquiry, it was learned that the couple had given birth to twins, a boy and a girl, before the New Year. They were premature and had died, and were buried on that hill..."

Yun Chu smiled.

Heaven had truly helped Xie Jingyu; he had even managed to find a pair of twins born around the same time as her children. She had been deceived completely.

Reincarnated into a new life, only to be deceived again. She truly deserved it.

Xie Jingyu and Xie Shian were equally hypocritical. No matter how she questioned them, they would never reveal a word.

The breakthrough lay with He Shi.

Originally, she had planned to wait until Xie Shian entered the Imperial College in the autumn before exposing He Shi’s identity. At that time, it would surely be a bloody storm.

But she couldn’t wait until autumn.

In the afternoon, while Yun Chu was in the courtyard reviewing the accounts for the ice shop, Ling Yu entered and said, "Madam, Aunt Tao’s child was born prematurely and is weak. In any case, it has a bit to do with Young Master You. This concubine wants to seek a peace talisman from the temple for the fourth young master, as a way for Young Master You to make amends. At the same time, I’ll also get one for the old madam. I beg for your permission, Madam."

Yun Chu could see what she was plotting and nodded, arranging a coachman for her.

Ever since the birthday banquet incident, the old madam’s health had not been as robust as before. She often had a cough and was constantly drinking medicine to regulate her condition, but to no avail.

After drinking her medicine, the old madam frowned. "Regarding Aunt Tao’s premature birth, Jingyu is just going to let it slide?"

Mama Zhou nodded. "The third young master is still young. He couldn’t have done such a thing. It must have been an accident."

The old madam shook her head.

Even Wei Ge, at only eight years old, had been capable of the demonic act of inserting a hundred needles into a maid’s body. She was afraid that Young Master You also harbored a demon within him.

Their Xie family had been scholarly for generations. How had they ended up raising two such unfilial wretches in a row?

Thank goodness An Ge was a good child. Otherwise, in this vast Xie residence, there wouldn’t even be a single person capable of supporting the family’s reputation.

As they were speaking, a servant reported that Aunt Yu had arrived.

"Greetings, Old Madam." Ling Yu curtsied. "This concubine went to Qing’an Temple this afternoon and obtained peace talismans for the fourth young master and the Old Madam."

The old madam saw that the peace talismans were indeed from Qing’an Temple and softened her expression. "You have a kind heart."

Though she disliked this disloyal, bed-hopping Aunt Yu, the fact that she had sincerely obtained peace talismans for her showed more care than that granddaughter-in-law, Yun Chu.

"Old Madam, the master at the temple said something to this concubine." Ling Yu lowered her head. "The master said that the fourth young master’s accident is only the beginning..."

"What do you mean?" The old madam set down her teacup heavily. "Explain yourself!"

Ling Yu seemed frightened and quickly said, "The master said that our Xie family has been cursed by one of our own. Several young masters will suffer misfortunes one after another... If we do not remove the cursed object, the Xie family may face the end of its lineage..."

"How dare you!" The old madam smashed her teacup directly onto Ling Yu. "This is nothing but nonsense!"

Ling Yu shrank back. "Old Madam, it’s better to believe it than not. Think about it, the second young master’s leg was broken, the fourth young master was born prematurely, and now Young Master You is also ill. What if the eldest young master..."

The old madam felt a chill run down her spine.

In recent times, far too many misfortunes had befallen the Xie family. Apart from Xian Mei finding a good marriage, everything else had been a disaster.

Could it be that they were truly cursed?

"Old Madam, let the master come to our Xie family to take a look. If he finds nothing, then we’ve only lost some silver. But if he does find something, then he may save the entire Xie family!" Ling Yu pleaded. "Old Madam, for the sake of the young masters, for the sake of the Xie family, we cannot delay this!"

chapters.title: The Truth Uncovered
chapters.content:
The next day was another bright, sunny morning.

Early in the morning, a servant led a master into the Xie residence.

The old madam, accompanied by many servants, watched the master perform his rituals in the spacious courtyard.

He’s eyelids twitched continuously. She whispered, "Old Madam, where did this master come from? Why do I feel his methods are a bit strange?"

When she was young, her family had encountered misfortune. After returning to her hometown, her elders often invited masters to perform rituals, but none of them did it like this.

Yin Yu’s heart skipped a beat.

She had lied to the old madam, saying this master was from Qing’an Temple, but in reality, he wasn’t. The masters at Qing’an Temple were falsely pretentious and refused to take her money. Maybe they thought it was too little. On her way back from Qing’an Temple, she had met this master, who was cheap and obedient...

"Concubine He, every master has their own habits," Yin Yu said. "We don’t understand these things. Let’s just wait and see."

Yun Chu stood beside the old madam and said, "It’s just a blessing for the Xie family. It doesn’t matter where the master is from."

The old madam’s face was stern, and she said nothing.

Her eyes were fixed on the master in the center of the courtyard. The master held a talisman, threw it into the air, and shouted. The talisman suddenly ignited.

Then, the master’s sharp gaze swept over the women.

Jiang Concubine, who was timid, was startled and subconsciously grabbed Xie Xian’s hand.

"There is a malevolent spirit in this residence!" the master shouted. Suddenly, a flame appeared above his head, and the flame drifted toward the back courtyard.

Without a word, everyone in the courtyard followed the master to the back courtyard. The flame flickered, sometimes east, sometimes west, and finally stopped above a courtyard in the middle.

It was still midsummer, and the courtyard was filled with blooming lotus flowers and lush leaves. It was He Concubine’s Bihe Garden.

He Concubine frowned, feeling uneasy.

She felt like something was about to happen...

The ghostly flame stopped above the lotus pond and extinguished with a *pu* sound, and the ashes fell from the sky.

"Right there!" the master stepped forward, stood by the lake, and said to the Xie family, "Madam Xie, please have someone search there, and you will know what happened."

The old madam looked over. It was midsummer, and the lotus flowers were in full bloom. Could there be something in the pond that shouldn’t be there?

Thinking of a possibility, her face darkened even more.

Mama Zhou had already led two servants over. In a few moves, they found a rope and pulled up a small red lacquered box.

He Concubine’s eyes widened.

How could there be a box in the pond of her courtyard? Who put it there?

What were they trying to do?

Before she could think more, the box was presented to the old madam.

The old madam felt a sense of unease and ordered, "Open it."

Mama Zhou opened the box. When everyone saw what was inside, their expressions changed.

Inside the box were three dolls. Judging by their clothes, one was an old woman, one was a woman in her forties, and the other was a young woman in her twenties.

The old woman’s doll had silver needles piercing its chest. The second doll had needles in its eyes, hands, and feet. The third doll, the young madam, was covered in needles all over its body...

The scene was terrifying.

"This... this is Old Madam, Madam, and Mistress!" Tingshuang exclaimed. "Heavens, someone has cursed the Xie family women to die horribly!"

Yuan Shi also recognized them. These three outfits were those of the three generations of mistresses of the Xie family. Who was so vicious?

Yun Chu’s face showed just the right amount of shock. "Who is so bold as to curse me? But how dare they curse Madam and Old Madam! Old Madam has been unwell lately. Could it be related to this curse?"

She turned to look at the old madam and saw her holding onto Mama Zhou beside her, her legs seemingly weakened by fear.

The older one got, the more one feared death. No elderly person could withstand such a shock. The old madam’s chest heaved violently, and her breathing was audible.

*Cough, cough, cough!*

The old madam coughed violently.

Mama Zhou quickly took out a handkerchief to cover her mouth. When she saw it, there were streaks of blood. She was terribly frightened.

The old madam’s turbid eyes rolled and she looked at He Concubine. "It’s you!"

He Concubine was also extremely shocked when she saw the dolls in the box. Only now did she realize that the box was found in her courtyard!

She shuddered and quickly said, "Old Madam, I have been wronged! I have never done such a thing. Please, Old Madam, investigate clearly!"

"Who else could it be but you!" The old madam raised her hand and slapped her. "You wicked woman, the Xie family should never have kept you!"

Years ago, this wicked woman had seduced Jing Yu. Jing Yu had been so infatuated that he wanted to marry her, but she had refused. Over the years, this wicked woman must have harbored resentment.

And Yun Chu had taken the position of the legitimate wife. This wicked woman must wish Yun Chu would drop dead!

Did she think that if all the mistresses of the Xie family died, it would be her turn, an improper concubine, to become the mistress?

Dream on!

"Old Madam, Concubine He has no reason to do this!" Xie Pin couldn’t help but step forward. "Moreover, even if she had such a heart, she wouldn’t place this thing in her own courtyard. Someone must have framed her. Today’s incident was driven by Concubine Yu. It’s hard not to suspect that Concubine Yu is behind this!"

"Miss Xie really thinks too highly of me." Tingyu lowered her eyes. "We are both concubines. Miss Xie shouldn’t help Concubine He just because you look alike and accuse me!"

These words immediately changed Xie Pin’s expression.

Although she wanted to speak for He Concubine, she didn’t want to involve herself.

She pursed her lips and said nothing.

"Concubine He, I have never treated you unfairly, and no one in the Xie family has treated you unfairly. How could you do such an unforgivable thing!" Yun Chu’s face was icy. "Come, take Concubine He to the firewood room. Tingshuang, arrange for someone to invite the master back!"

"I am truly wronged!" He Concubine repeatedly defended herself. "Concubine Yu resents me for taking Yun Ge’er away, so she conspired with that master to frame me! Old Madam, Madam, Mistress, I am truly wronged! You can send people to search Concubine Yu’s courtyard. She made so many dolls. There must be some traces in her courtyard!"

Tingyu secretly smiled.

These dolls were made by Concubine Tao. It was also Concubine Tao who, in the middle of the night, dragged her post-childbirth body to place them in the pond.

As for her, she was only responsible for paying the silver and finding the master to frame He Concubine.

From beginning to end, she and Concubine Tao had done everything themselves. Even if the servants in their courtyards were severely interrogated, nothing would be found, let alone any incriminating evidence!

"This matter will be investigated clearly when the master returns!" Yun Chu said solemnly. "If it’s not you, it naturally won’t be blamed on you! What are you waiting for? Take Concubine He away!"

Several sturdy maids came forward, one on each side, and dragged He Concubine toward the back courtyard.

The old madam closed her eyes.

If it weren’t for He Concubine giving birth to three children for the Xie family, she would have had her drowned in the lake.

---

chapters.title: The Old Madam Coughs Up Blood
chapters.content:
Xie Jingyu and Xie Shian returned to the residence at the same time.

The father and son exchanged a glance and first went to Yun Chu’s Sheng Ju.

"Husband, you’ve finally returned." Yun Chu’s face was cold. "I just had people re-examine the curse incident. It was indeed Concubine He’s doing. Husband, how do you think we should handle this?"

Xie Shian tightened his fingers. "Mother, send Concubine He away."

Two months ago, he had wanted his father to send He Concubine out of the Xie family, but she had insisted on staying, causing so many problems.

If she stayed any longer, who knew what else would happen...

"Send her to the estate." Xie Jingyu said, "Let her keep Wei Ge’er company."

Yun Chu took a few letters from the table and handed them over. "When we searched Bihe Garden, the servants found these things. Does Husband recognize them?"

Xie Jingyu didn’t know why she suddenly changed the subject. He suspiciously took the items and glanced at them. His expression suddenly changed.

Xie Shian took a look, and his expression froze.

These were letters exchanged between He Concubine and her maternal grandfather’s family from a few years ago!

He had long told He Concubine to burn these things. Why were they still found?

"Judging by Husband and An Ge’er’s expressions, you must have known Concubine He’s identity for a long time." Yun Chu turned around and took a few embroidered handkerchiefs from the desk. "Not long ago, Concubine He sold some embroidery. A merchant bought a large quantity and even sent someone to the Xie family to inquire about Concubine He. At that time, I didn’t know why. Now that I’ve seen these letters, I understand. It turns out that Concubine He is the legitimate granddaughter of He Tao, the Minister of Revenue from twenty years ago! The embroidery techniques she uses seem to be the unique needlework of the He family! If I can find out, others can too."

Xie Jingyu felt unsteady on his feet.

Someone was investigating He Concubine’s identity. What did this mean? It meant someone was targeting the Xie family and suspected that He Concubine was related to the He family from over twenty years ago!

Although the He family’s downfall was over twenty years ago, and the court did not prohibit the He family’s descendants from marrying, once connected to the descendants of a criminal, if impeached by the Censorate, his official career would definitely be affected.

If he wasn’t an official in the Ministry of Revenue, it would be fine. Even if others were suspicious, they wouldn’t say anything.

But he was a fifth-rank official in the Ministry of Revenue, and he had taken the granddaughter of the former Minister of Revenue as a concubine. Would the court think he was emulating the He family’s corruption and bribery...

And during this time, to prepare for Xie Pin’s dowry, he had indeed accepted many things he shouldn’t have.

"The law of our dynasty states that if one forms a marriage with the descendants of a criminal, it must be reported to the court." Yun Chu said, word by word. "Looking at Husband’s expression, it seems you haven’t reported this to the court."

Xie Jingyu closed his eyes.

How could he dare to report it? Wasn’t that asking for trouble?

When he first met He Concubine, he only knew her as He Ling Ying. He had no idea she was from the He family. It wasn’t until after Xie Pin was born that she revealed her identity.

At that time, he and she were deeply in love, and he had not yet entered the court as an official. He didn’t take He Concubine’s identity seriously. He secretly arranged a residence and kept her as an external concubine. Soon after, she gave birth to An Ge’er, and then Wei Ge’er.

Over the years, no one had ever suspected He Concubine’s identity. Even he himself had gradually forgotten that her original surname was He.

But now, someone was investigating He Concubine. He could no longer deceive himself.

He took a deep breath and said, "She’s just a concubine. There’s no need to report to the court. She has made a mistake. It’s just as well to send her away. Send her far away, north or south. As long as the Xie family cuts ties with her, even if her identity is exposed, it won’t affect the Xie family."

After he finished speaking, he looked at his eldest son beside him.

Xie Shian’s lips were tightly pressed, and his fingers were clenched into fists.

After a long time, a determined look appeared on his face. "Then, as Father said, send her far away."

As long as He Concubine was gone, even if someone investigated her identity again, it would be difficult to find anything. Even if they did, by then, the Xie family would have no connection to her... He would secretly protect her and ensure she had no worries for the rest of her life.

"Do you think that if Concubine He leaves, everything will be fine?" Yun Chu lowered her eyes. "In fact, Concubine He is the biological mother of An Ge’er, Wei Ge’er, and Pin’er."

Xie Jingyu was suddenly stunned.

Not only was He Concubine’s identity exposed, but Yun Chu also knew that An Ge’er and the other two were her biological children.

She was so calm, which clearly meant she had known about this for a long time. Why hadn’t he noticed anything?

Xie Shian had never expected to hear these words. Many thoughts flashed through his mind, and the last one was what he considered heartfelt: "He Concubine only gave me life. You, Mother, are my true mother."

Xie Jingyu swallowed hard and said, "Madam, things are not as you think. Although He Concubine is the children’s mother, I have never thought of having any further relationship with her. If it weren’t for the accident at the banquet last time, she would have forever been just a servant of the Xie family, not Concubine He. Please, Madam, do not hold any grudges."

"Now is not the time to say these things. Husband, you should think carefully about how to handle Concubine He’s matter." Yun Chu walked out. "I’m going to see the old madam."

As soon as she left, Xie Jingyu collapsed into the chair.

When she arrived at An Shou Hall, before even entering the room, Yun Chu heard Xie Pin speaking: "Concubine He would never do such a thing. Even if she really wanted to be the mistress of the household, she wouldn’t curse Old Madam and Grandmother. This must be a setup. There must be a hidden truth. Old Madam, please have someone investigate again!"

The old madam was reclining on the couch. After drinking her medicine, she said, "Pin’er, do you have to defend He Concubine?"

"Old Madam, you are unaware." Yun Chu entered from the doorway. "Concubine He is Pin’er’s biological mother. Of course, she has to defend her own mother. She’s not wrong."

Xie Pin suddenly turned her head. "Mo... Mother..."

"Chu’er, what nonsense are you talking about." The old madam’s fingers stiffened for a moment, then she pretended as if nothing happened. "Pin’er’s biological mother died long ago. Now, you are her mother!"

"An Ge’er has already told me that Concubine He is the biological mother of them three siblings." Yun Chu’s expression was calm. "I just don’t know if Old Madam is aware of He Concubine’s original identity."

*Boom!* Xie Pin felt like thunder was ringing in her ears, and her body seemed to lose control as she slid downward.

She hadn’t even processed the first statement when the next one made it even harder for her to react. She held onto the maid’s hand to keep herself from falling to the ground.

The old madam’s eyebrows twitched. "What other identity could He Concubine have besides being a concubine of the Xie family?"

She was still pondering the first statement. Her granddaughter-in-law already knew that He Concubine was the mother of the children. She would probably make a fuss because initially, it was said that An Ge’er’s mother had died, which was why her granddaughter-in-law had accepted the three children as legitimate... Now, the dead person had become a concubine in the residence. Her granddaughter-in-law would definitely feel deceived by the Xie family. If she made a scene at the Yun family, it would be terrible...

While the old madam was lost in thought, she heard Yun Chu say, "Concubine He’s grandfather was He Tao, the Minister of Revenue from over twenty years ago, the same He Tao who, due to corruption and bribery, caused all males above seven years old in his three clans to be beheaded."

chapters.title: His Turn to Choose
chapters.content:
Madam Xie suddenly sat up from the couch.

More than twenty years ago, the Xie family was still nothing, so as a woman, she naturally paid no attention to the cases at court.

But she understood clearly; He Shi was the descendant of the criminal official He family. Her eldest grandson, Jingyu, had actually taken a criminal's daughter as his concubine!

At this moment, she finally realized why He Shi, who had once been desperate to marry Jingyu, had given up on the idea of marrying into the family after Jingyu became an official!

She also understood why, despite her repeated attempts to make He Shi a concubine, He Shi had always been unwilling!

Because that wretched woman knew her own identity, knew she would bring trouble to the Xie family, knew she would ruin the futures of the children!

"That, that was more than twenty years ago..." Xie Pin stammered, her lips trembling. "The He family has already received their due punishment. Over a hundred people from the three clans are nearly extinct... The court has long stopped investigating the He family's past crimes. Even if people know that Father took a He family woman as a concubine, it won't matter... Although I am He Shi's daughter, I only recognize my mother as my mother..."

Yun Chu sneered inwardly.

Xie Pin and Xie Shian were truly siblings, cut from the same cloth in their selfishness. They were afraid that she, as the legitimate wife, would abandon them once she knew the truth.

She suppressed her cold mockery and spoke, "Sister Ping, you are still too young. Think about it, back then, so many people from the He family were beheaded, and a century-old aristocratic family was destroyed just like that. Do you think the surviving members of the He family hold no grudges? Do you think the Emperor and the court are unaware of the resentment in their hearts? If the He family stays far away where they belong, the Emperor and the court won't say anything. But, "

She paused, then continued, "Brother An is about to enter the Imperial Academy, and Sister Ping, you are about to marry into the Prince Anjing's mansion. You two are descendants of a criminal, yet you are in such close proximity to the royal family. Who can guarantee that you won't vent your resentment on the royal family? If your identities are exposed, every single member of the Xie family will have to pay the price!"

Madam Xie felt a surge of bitterness in her throat.

Even a young girl like Ping knew He Shi's identity, yet she had been deceived for so long!

If they really waited until Brother An entered the Imperial Academy and Sister Ping became the Princess Consort of Anjing, the Xie family would surely be charged with the crime of deceiving the Emperor!

The Xie family had gone through three generations, decades of hard work, finally reaching the capital, finally getting to this point, only to be destroyed by that wretched woman He Shi!

No more Imperial Academy!

No marriage to Prince Anjing!

*Pu!*

Madam Xie couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood.

"Chu!"

Madam Xie grabbed Yun Chu's hand.

Yun Chu handed the old lady a cup of tea, "Madam, please don't be angry. My husband and Brother An are thinking of a way. From what they say, they plan to send Concubine He to the south or the north."

Xie Pin nodded like a pestle, "Yes, yes, send her away, the farther the better. As long as no one ever knows He Shi's identity, it will be fine."

"Madam, today's curse incident is enough to show that He Shi also harbors resentment toward our Xie family. Maybe she resents you for not letting her into the family back then, or maybe she resents me for taking the position of the legitimate wife." Yun Chu spoke, "If the Xie family sends her away, the resentment in her heart will only grow. If she does something else later, it won't be something we can control."

Madam Xie's heart sank, "Chu, what do you mean?"

Yun Chu remained silent.

"Chu, I know that Jingyu has wronged you, that the Xie family has let you down, deceived you. We will make it up to you later!" Madam Xie's voice was pleading. "But the three children, Brother An, Brother Wei, and Sister Ping, all sincerely accept you as their mother. Can you bear to watch their futures be ruined? You and Jingyu are one in marriage; you are the wife of the Xie family. The Xie family has come this far with great difficulty. Can you bear to watch Jingyu's official career end here?"

Yun Chu stood up, lowering her eyes, "I want to see how the Xie family acts before deciding whether I will remain the wife of the Xie family."

With that, she turned and walked out of Anshou Hall.

Madam Xie's mind was in turmoil.

Did Chu mean that she wanted to sever ties with the Xie family? Was she asking for a divorce?

Heaven, the Xie family having He Shi, a descendant of a criminal, was already a devastating blow. If Yun Chu also left, the Xie family would truly never recover.

"Sister Ping, help me up!"

Madam Xie struggled to get up from the couch, with Mama Zhou and Xie Pin supporting her on either side.

When the voodoo doll was discovered, Madam Xie had already coughed up blood. After spitting out a large mouthful just now, her body was already weak.

But the old lady knew that even if she couldn't hold on, she had to get up. Otherwise, it would be the Xie family that couldn't hold on.

Soon, they arrived at Xie Jingyu's courtyard. The servants were all busy with their tasks, but the atmosphere in the study was extremely heavy.

After Madam Xie entered, Mama Zhou closed the study door and stood guard on the steps, not allowing any servants to approach.

"Grandmother, why have you come?"

Xie Jingyu quickly helped Madam Xie sit in a chair and placed a soft cushion behind her.

"I already know about He Shi." Madam Xie got straight to the point. "Jingyu, you and Brother An have discussed this for so long. What have you decided to do with her?"

Xie Jingyu pressed his lips together.

Xie Shian clenched his fists.

Although the father and son had been alone for so long, they hadn't actually discussed much because there was no way out.

Keeping He Shi in the Xie mansion was impossible.

But if they sent He Shi away, would that really be safe?

Now that someone was watching the Xie family, once He Shi left the mansion, she might fall into the hands of someone with ill intentions. By then, it would be too late to fix anything.

"I have a way."

As soon as Madam Xie spoke, everyone's gaze fell on her.

"If He Shi is dead, then there will be no evidence." Madam Xie spoke slowly and clearly, "It depends on whether you can bear to do it."

Xie Pin felt dizzy, "No..."

Although she despised He Shi, her biological mother, she had never thought of killing her.

Xie Jingyu supported himself on the desk, his face filled with shock. How could Grandmother say such a cruel thing so lightly?

He and He Shi had met and fallen in love in their youth, and they had three children together. Although their feelings weren't as deep now, he could never bring himself to kill He Shi.

The study fell into silence.

In the midst of this silence, Xie Shian spoke, "If Father wants to go further in his official career, if Elder Sister wants to marry into the royal family securely, if I want to enter the Imperial Academy, if the Xie family wants to become the new nobility of the court... then He Shi can only... die."

Xie Pin's face turned pale.

She couldn't believe that Brother An would say such heartless words. It was normal for Grandmother to suggest killing He Shi since they had no blood relation, but Brother An shared half of He Shi's blood. How could he bring himself to kill his own mother?

Shouldn't he be persuading Grandmother to change her mind?

Xie Jingyu closed his eyes, "Then... as Grandmother says."

Madam Xie struggled to stand up, "Brother An, you truly understand the bigger picture. Then, this matter will be left to you. Sister Ping will assist you. You are He Shi's children. For your sakes, she will surely be willing to die."

Xie Pin almost collapsed.

---

chapters.title: The Death of Concubine He
chapters.content:
The night was dark, and the stars were sparse.

He Shi was locked in a secluded firewood shed.

In this quiet place, her mind was clear enough to slowly understand what was happening.

This must be a scheme by Concubine Yu and Concubine Tao. The voodoo dolls were probably made by Concubine Tao, and the master was likely hired by Concubine Yu. The madam must have known about their plot and deliberately fanned the flames...

Once the master returned to the mansion, he would surely clear her name.

As she was lost in thought, she heard the lock rattle. By the light of the moon outside, she saw two people enter.

One was Brother An, the other was Sister Ping.

A look of joy flashed in her eyes.

Since returning to the Xie family, the children had rarely come to see her to avoid suspicion.

In the past, whenever she was in trouble, the children had never come to visit her. To be honest, as their biological mother, she felt a slight sense of loss.

But now, seeing the siblings enter the firewood shed, that slight loss in her heart instantly disappeared.

She knew that in the children's hearts, she, their biological mother, was irreplaceable.

"Why have you two come?" He Shi stood up to greet them.

Xie Pin stood behind Xie Shian, tightly clutching the handkerchief in her hand, completely at a loss for words.

Xie Shian spoke, "Mother, Grandmother and our mother know about you."

He Shi's body swayed, "Brother An, what did you say? I didn't hear clearly. Say it again."

"You are the granddaughter of He Tao, the former Minister of Revenue from over twenty years ago. You are a descendant of the He family. The three children you gave birth to are also descendants of a criminal." Xie Shian's voice was extremely hoarse. "Although the court did not exterminate the entire He family, it will never allow the descendants of a criminal to enter officialdom, nor will it allow Elder Sister to marry into the royal family... Because of your identity, we are doomed to have no future."

He Shi felt as if her heart was being squeezed, and her breathing became difficult. "H-How could anyone have found out?"

She had hidden it so well, changed her surname, and stayed far away from her clan's residence. Who could have discovered her identity?

She also knew that descendants of the He family could never enter the court or marry a prince. That was why she had never dared to be a mother to her children.

She had endured for so many years, handing over her three children to others to raise. Why had it all come to nothing in the end?

Her knees buckled, and she leaned against the wall.

Xie Shian walked over, supporting her arm, and helped her sit on the straw mat on the floor of the firewood shed. "The embroidered items you sold were seen by someone with ill intentions. They are now investigating the Xie family and your identity."

He Shi's lips trembled.

Some time ago, the private savings she had were all taken by that wretched woman Concubine Tao. The money she had deposited in the bank had been gambled away by that scoundrel brother of hers. Penniless and unable to move freely in the Xie mansion, she had no choice but to embroider handkerchiefs and screens to exchange for money...

Why, after more than twenty years, could someone still recognize the He family's embroidery?

"Mother."

Xie Shian suddenly called out.

This address pulled He Shi's memories back to many years ago when she was Xie Jingyu's mistress, and her three children were raised by her side.

Sister Ping was sensible, Brother An was clever, and Brother Wei was mischievous, all were her children, surrounding her and calling her mother every day.

After the children were claimed by the Xie family, apart from the occasional "Mother" from Brother Wei, she had never heard Brother An or Sister Ping call her that again.

He Shi's eyelashes trembled, and tears uncontrollably streamed down her face.

She didn't know why, but a strong sense of unease suddenly welled up in her heart. This address of "Mother" brought that unease to its peak.

She reached out and touched Xie Shian's face, "Brother An, from now on... don't call me Mother anymore. With my identity, I will only hold you back... Have your father send me away. I cannot implicate you all..."

"If you leave, will everything be fine?" Xie Pin bit her lip and paused for a long time before continuing, "If you truly care for us, then you should... you should..."

She couldn't bring herself to say the last few words, as if something was choking her throat.

Xie Shian suddenly remembered a story his mother had told him two months ago.

It was about a peasant woman who raised three children who were not her own. She had poured her heart and soul into raising them.

But one day, the peasant woman was involved in a rebellion, and the three children, for the sake of their family, killed their adoptive mother.

At that time, his mother had asked him whether the three children were right or wrong...

What had he answered?

He couldn't remember.

Now, it was his turn to choose.

He lowered his head, unable to believe that he could make the choice most beneficial to himself without any hesitation.

For the first time, he realized that he was such a selfish and cold-blooded monster.

He took out a porcelain bottle from his sleeve, "This is from Father. Drink it. You will slowly fall asleep within a quarter of an hour and die without pain..."

He Shi's pupils contracted sharply.

She finally understood the unease in her heart. It was her own children, whom she had carried for ten months and given birth to, who were going to feed her poison.

Even if it were someone else, even if it were Grandmother, she could accept it.

But why did it have to be Brother An and Sister Ping?

"No!!"

He Shi couldn't help but let out a scream.

"Mother." Xie Shian, however, remained very calm. "Hundreds of people from the He family died in that case more than twenty years ago. The century-old He family was destroyed just like that. Now, how many people in the capital still remember the He family? In the last letter left by our great-grandfather before his death, it was clearly written that he hoped the descendants of the He family would be able to overturn the case and restore the He family's glory. It is because I held onto this belief that I was able to become the top scholar at the age of twelve..."

He Shi burst into tears.

When the He family's disaster struck, she was already old enough to remember. She was the youngest legitimate daughter of the He family, and her grandfather had doted on her greatly.

She knew her grandfather's last wish, but she didn't believe she had the ability to fulfill it. As for that good-for-nothing He Xu, he was even less capable of restoring the He family.

All hope now rested on Brother An...

If Brother An's identity as a descendant of the He family were exposed, then he wouldn't be able to enter the Imperial Academy, take the imperial examinations, or pursue an official career...

He Shi's sobs echoed from the firewood shed.

Yun Chu stood on the steps outside, listening clearly to the conversation between the mother and her children.

She thought of her previous life. Under a similar night sky, she had been persuaded by Xie Shian to drink poison, asking her to die for the sake of the Xie family.

At that time, the Xie family's situation was still unresolved, so how could she have agreed to die? As a result, the children had come over to hold her down and poured the poison down her throat...

She had drunk the poison, which had caused excruciating pain throughout her body, as if her bones and internal organs were being torn apart.

The poison He Shi was about to drink was painless, allowing her to die silently. In a way, she was lucky.

He Shi did not feel lucky at all.

Being forced to die by her own son and daughter, what kind of terrible karma had she accumulated to deserve such heart-wrenching pain?

Seeing that He Shi was not moving, Xie Pin stepped forward, took the porcelain bottle, opened the lid, and a fragrant aroma wafted out. Her voice trembled, "Do you want us to force you to drink it?"

chapters.title: What a Coincidence
chapters.content:
He Shi gradually stopped crying.

She looked at her two children, her expression filled with sorrow. "I wonder how Wei Ge'er is doing..."

"Don't worry, I will arrange for someone to take care of Wei Ge'er." Xie Shian spoke, "It's getting late, drink it."

He Shi took the porcelain bottle. She smelled the rich fragrance and believed what the children had said, that the poison would not cause suffering. After drinking it, she would fall asleep, and everything would be over.

But she was unwilling.

The He family had not yet been restored.

The children were not yet grown.

She had not even seen Yu Lang one last time.

He Shi closed her eyes, tilted her head back, and drank all the sweet poison from the porcelain bottle.

As soon as the poison went down, the door to the firewood room was pushed open.

It was Yun Chu who entered.

With a complex expression, she said, "An Ge'er, Ping Jie'er, leave this matter to me. You two are tired; go back and rest."

Xie Pin had watched her own mother drink the poison. She was completely devastated, her body trembling. Hearing Yun Chu's words, she didn't dare to look at He Shi again. Grabbing the maid's hand, she hurried out.

Xie Shian had only been barely holding on. He had done what he needed to do. He couldn't bear to watch He Shi die before his eyes.

He stood up, stumbled, steadied himself against the wall, and walked out.

Tingshuang and Tingfeng stood guard at the door and closed the firewood room's door.

Although He Shi had drunk the poison, she indeed did not feel any pain. Her gaze fell on Yun Chu, and she suddenly gave a tragic laugh. "The decision was made by the Old Madam, the poison was given by the Master, and it was An Ge'er and Ping Jie'er who fed it to me. Madam, you have absolved yourself of all blame quite neatly."

"Didn't I come to collect your body?" Yun Chu looked down at her from a height. "They say that when a person is about to die, their words are kind. He Ling Sheng, I have a few questions for you. Answer me properly."

He Shi heard her maiden name and felt a wave of dizziness.

She gave a cold laugh. "I have fallen to this point, and Madam, you had a hand in it, didn't you? Do you think I would answer your questions?"

"Being able to guess my involvement means you're not entirely stupid." Yun Chu smirked. "Let me tell you something more: the incident where Xie Shiwei angered the Marquis of Xuanwu also had my hand in it. How's that? Surprised?"

"You, !"

He Shi truly had not expected that this matter was also connected to Yun Chu.

She wished she could strangle the person before her.

Yun Chu looked at her and slowly said, "If you don't answer my questions properly, the fate of Xie Shian and Xie Pin will be the same as Xie Shiwei's."

He Shi gritted her teeth. "When did you find out that they are my children?"

Long ago, she had felt that Madam was deliberately targeting the children, but no one had believed her.

No wonder Madam had suddenly changed. Everyone in the Xie household had been punished by Madam. It turned out that Madam had known all along that the Xie family had deceived her.

Yun Chu did not answer her question. Instead, she asked, "Before the New Year, my pair of twins I gave birth to; where did they end up?"

He Shi's heart jolted, and she lowered her head. "Weren't Madam's children reburied next to the Cloud family's ancestral temple? Why ask me?"

After saying this, she felt her legs go weak, as if they could no longer support her body. A clear sensation of life slipping away surged through her...

"The price for being stubborn once is Ping Jie'er's dowry." Yun Chu said lightly, as if it were nothing. "I'll give you one more chance."

He Shi bit her lip hard.

"Not going to talk?" Yun Chu smiled. "You don't cherish the last chance either. Then don't blame me. An Ge'er and Ping Jie'er..."

"I'll talk, I'll talk!" He Shi collapsed softly onto the straw mat, her voice no longer as strong as before. "Madam's twins were handed over to the Master by the midwife. The Master personally carried the children out of the Xie household. Apart from the Master, no one knows where the children were abandoned."

Yun Chu closed her eyes. "Were the children still alive at that time?"

He Shi gave a self-mocking smile.

So Madam knew everything. Yu Lang had thrown away the children while they were still alive. How could Madam let Yu Lang off?
