But before her death, Yu Lang hadn't even come to see her once. Why should she still worry about that heartless man?

"Yes, the children were still alive." He Shi found breathing difficult. "Madam, I've told you everything you asked. Promise me, even if you can't treat An Ge'er and Ping Jie'er well, please... please don't ruin their futures. I beg you, Madam..."

With the last of her strength, she grabbed Yun Chu's ankle.

Yun Chu lightly lifted her foot, and He Shi rolled onto the straw mat like a fallen leaf.

Lying on the mat, she breathed heavily, then suddenly began to cough violently. Blood overflowed from the corner of her mouth, her eyes widened to the maximum, and then she lost her breath.

Yun Chu sighed.

Xie Shian and Xie Pin had joined forces to drive He Shi to her death, yet in her final moments, what she cared about most were still those two children.

She looked at He Shi's wide-open, unseeing eyes and shook her head. Then she walked out of the firewood room.

As she stepped out, she looked up and saw Xie Jingyu standing at the entrance of the small courtyard.

"Husband, you've come." Yun Chu said, "Aunt He kept saying she wanted to see you one last time. She didn't get her wish even before her death, so she died with her eyes open."

Xie Jingyu's eyes reddened.

He and He Shi had known each other since they were young and had been through so much together. How could he bear to watch her go from a living person to a corpse?

He had wronged He Shi, and he had wronged Yun Chu. He didn't know how to face all of this.

He turned and left.

Yun Chu said indifferently, "Are you sure you don't want to go in and take a look?"

Xie Jingyu paused but did not turn around. He continued walking away.

Yun Chu's gaze turned icy.

Why had she married such a selfish and cowardly man?

She ordered the servants in the courtyard, "Prepare a simple coffin and bury her."

The servants did not dare to breathe loudly and hurried to carry out the order.

Xie Jingyu returned to his study and sat for more than an hour before the palpitations in his chest finally subsided.

He stood up and went to the firewood room again, only to find it empty. Upon inquiry, he learned that He Shi's body had already been taken outside the city...

That night, Xie Jingyu barely slept. Every time he closed his eyes, he saw He Shi's bloodshot eyes staring at him tragically.

He regretted not seeing He Shi one last time, regretted not letting her rest in peace...

In the morning, he had a splitting headache and couldn't even attend the morning court session. He hastily sent a servant to request leave.

After lying on the couch for a while, a servant came to report, "Master, Madam is here."

Xie Jingyu was somewhat afraid to face Yun Chu.

He had deceived her by saying that the mother of An Ge'er and the others was dead, which was why Yun Chu had treated the children with all her heart. It wasn't that He Shi's death meant he didn't have to explain this matter.

There had never been much affection between them as husband and wife, and now, there was even less.

He was afraid, afraid that Yun Chu would ask for a divorce.

If she really did, should he agree or refuse?

Did he even have the right to refuse?

At this moment, the door to the room was pushed open, and Yun Chu walked in. "I heard from the servant that you are ill and even requested leave from the court. Why didn't you call for a physician?"

---

chapters.title: The Person from the Wedding Night
chapters.content:
Xie Jingyu got up from the couch.

"My head hurts a bit, maybe I caught a cold. It's nothing serious; there's no need to call for a physician."

Yun Chu said, "If it hurts badly, you should still call for one. Don't delay your court duties."

Xie Jingyu nodded in agreement.

He could hear a hint of concern in Yun Chu's voice, so she probably wasn't here to ask for a divorce.

Yun Chu turned around and took a medicine prescription from the maid Tingshuang's hands. "Husband, this is a medicinal diet prescribed by Physician Si for both of us. After taking it for half a year and then... being together, we can conceive a son."

Xie Jingyu's heart suddenly stopped.

After all that had happened, she still wanted to have a child with him?

"An Ge'er and Ping Jie'er have deceived me for so many years. I can't treat them as my own children anymore." Yun Chu looked distressed. "I can't wait to have a child of my own. You understand, don't you, Husband?"

Xie Jingyu was deeply moved. "It is I who have wronged you, Madam. It's all my fault. Rest assured, I will cooperate fully in nurturing my body to give you a legitimate son with our bloodline."

He instinctively wanted to hold Yun Chu's hand.

But remembering the scene where she kept washing her hands, he restrained himself.

He ordered the servants to prepare the medicine.

"This medicine is to be taken every other day. I will have someone deliver it every alternate day." After saying this, Yun Chu prepared to leave.

"Madam!"

Xie Jingyu called out to her.

Every time he closed his eyes, the image of He Shi's unblinking eyes filled his mind. He needed someone to talk to.

Yun Chu paused. "Does Husband have something else?"

"I..." Xie Jingyu racked his brain and pressed his temples. "The youngest son hasn't been named yet. Does Madam have any good suggestions?"

Yun Chu's expression remained indifferent.

"The youngest was born prematurely, and the physician said his body is weak. How about—" Xie Jingyu pondered for a moment. "We name him Xie Shikang, Kang Ge'er."

Yun Chu's fingers twitched.

In her previous life, the youngest was also named Xie Shikang, a name she had chosen.

In this life, many things were different, but the child still bore the same name. It was a terrifying fate.

"Then I will inform the Old Madam." Yun Chu said. "We can discuss when to add Kang Ge'er to the family registry."

She did not wish to stay longer and turned to leave.

As she walked out of the inner room, she saw two maids outside preparing the medicine. With a darkened expression, she tightened her lips and continued walking out.

She went to An Shou Hall. Before entering, she smelled the pungent odor of medicine.

This time, the Old Madam's health had truly deteriorated. Last night, she had coughed up blood several times. Now, her face was pale as she lay on the couch drinking medicine.

Yuan Shi sat beside her, attending to her needs. She sighed. "Old Madam, your body must have been harmed by that He Concubine. She actually practiced witchcraft in our Xie family. I wonder how Old Madam plans to punish her?"

"Mother, He Concubine took her own life out of guilt." Yun Chu stepped inside. "In consideration of her service to Husband, I took the initiative to arrange a simple coffin for her."

"What, what!" Yuan Shi dropped the medicine bowl in her hands. "He Concubine committed suicide? How could this be?"

Although practicing witchcraft was a grave crime, it wasn't punishable by death. How could she have committed suicide?

She was still alive and well yesterday, but today she was dead...

"Cough, cough, cough!" The Old Madam coughed violently, interrupting Yuan Shi's thoughts. "Bring another bowl of medicine."

Yuan Shi quickly stood up, took a bowl of medicine from a maid outside, and carefully fed it to the Old Madam. "The physician said you are ill from suppressed emotions. So many things have happened in our Xie family lately. Not to mention you, even I am a bit scared. But with Chu in the family, there won't be any major problems. Think about it, before Chu entered our household, I was bedridden for more than ten years. As soon as Chu arrived, my illness improved on its own. Chu is the blessing of our Xie family. Old Madam, your illness will soon be cured."

Yun Chu narrowed her eyes.

She remembered when she accompanied Xie Jingyu to the Marquis of Xuanwu's residence, the Marquis had said something—

"Five years ago, Lord Xie came to my door, asking me to provide an extremely rare divine medicine..."

Could it be—

A terrible guess formed in Yun Chu's mind.

After the Old Madam drank her medicine and fell asleep, Yun Chu and Yuan Shi walked outside.

"Mother, I have a question for you." She smiled as she spoke. "Five years ago, did you take the divine medicine that Husband obtained, which cured your illness?"

Yuan Shi replied, "I was ill for more than ten years. Jingyu sought countless divine medicines, and none of them worked. I had given up hope, but who knew that on the second day after you entered our household, Jingyu brought me a pill to take, and my illness slowly improved. It must be that you are destined to bring fortune. Otherwise, how could my illness have suddenly improved?"

Yes, how could there be such a coincidence?

How could it be that on the second day after she entered the household, Xie Jingyu obtained the divine medicine?

If she said it had nothing to do with her, she wouldn't believe it herself.

She hadn't thought about these things before, but now, as she recalled, chilling details emerged everywhere.

Xie Jingyu, oh Xie Jingyu, this weak and hypocritical man, this despicable creature unworthy of being human, how many more things was he hiding from her?

Yun Chu returned to her own courtyard.

Tingshuang came to report, "The eldest miss is also ill. A physician was called, and medicine was prescribed... The eldest young master seems fine; he still went to Huai De Academy to study."

Yun Chu felt that this illegitimate son was cold and selfish to a terrifying extent.

Last night, he had personally forced his own birth mother to her death, and today, he could still pretend as if nothing had happened and go to school.

A twelve-year-old child with such a mindset...

She said, "Arrange a reliable person to find out what the Marquis of Xuanwu has been doing these days and where he has been going."

It was a pity for He Shi. She had thought He Shi was an informed person and had set up such a grand scheme, but she still didn't find out what she wanted to know.

Now, she could only go to the Marquis of Xuanwu, knowing full well that there was danger, to investigate the truth.

There were some servants and managers in the front courtyard of the Xie residence who were also Yun Chu's people. However, they had not been specifically trained, and although they were loyal, they had never been assigned special tasks. Tingshuang was worried.

She walked to the front courtyard and at a glance saw Yu Ke, who was feeding the horses.

Yu Ke had come to the Xie family because of her. Since Madam had not assigned him any specific tasks, he often wandered around the front courtyard.

She remembered that day by the lake when he had draped his cloak over her shoulders.

Everyone's attention had been on Madam, including her own. Only this man had noticed that she, too, was drenched...

"Tingshuang?"

Seeing Tingshuang appear in the front courtyard, Yu Ke's face lit up with a smile, but then he became somewhat awkward and walked over.

"Madam has a task that needs to be done." Tingshuang maintained a professional demeanor. "If you have nothing else to do..."

"I have nothing to do; I'm just idle." Yu Ke smiled simply. "Just give me the order."

Tingshuang explained the task and then left.

Yu Ke scratched the back of his head.

Madam had said that he would stay at the Xie family for half a month. If he couldn't gain Tingshuang's approval within that time, then Tingshuang would find someone else for Madam.

As the days passed one by one without any progress, it truly made him anxious...

chapters.title: Thank You, Aunt Yun
chapters.content:
Yun Chu heard the maid’s report that Xie Jingyu had taken his medicine before she finally left the residence.

The carriage departed from the Xie mansion and slowly made its way to the busiest main street in the capital, stopping in front of a cockfighting arena.

People bustled in and out, and Yu Ke led the way, while Qiutong and Tingshuang flanked Yun Chu on either side as she entered.

After learning from Yu Ke that Marquis Xuande frequently visited this cockfighting arena, Yun Chu had someone reserve a private box on the second floor. Climbing the stairs, the upper floor was quieter with fewer people. She took her seat, ordered a pot of tea, and casually watched the scene below.

Two roosters were released into the arena, and the fight began quickly. The onlookers could place bets, and with luck, one could win a considerable amount of silver.

Yun Chu casually took out a coin purse and placed it on the tray the waiter handed over.

After about two rounds, even someone as clueless as Yun Chu managed to make a small profit.

Before long, she spotted Qin Mingheng entering through the first-floor entrance.

She remained seated, continuing to watch the cockfight.

Sure enough, after a short while, a voice sounded behind her: "Is that Madam Xie?"

Yun Chu turned her head, stood up, and bowed respectfully: "Greetings, Lord Marquis Xuande."

"You needn’t stand on ceremony with me out here." Qin Mingheng lightly supported her with his fan. "I never expected to run into Madam Xie at a cockfighting arena. Which rooster do you think will win?"

Yun Chu’s expression remained cold: "If Lord Marquis Xuande has no seat, why not join me?"

The place was crowded with people. The second floor had fewer people, but only relatively compared to the first floor. Many private boxes were already occupied by at least three or four people, both men and women.

In such a setting, talking about the separation of men and women was a joke.

Qin Mingheng was a little surprised that Yun Chu would invite him to sit with her, but he quickly realized that this woman must have been waiting for him here.

Last time, he had told her that if she wanted to know the truth, she should come to the Marquis’s mansion.

She didn’t dare to go to the Marquis Xuande’s mansion alone, so she chose this busy place, fearing that he might do something improper?

"Hmph."

Qin Mingheng gave a cold laugh and sat down at the table.

He reached out and took the cup of tea in front of Yun Chu, greedily inhaling the aroma. "Madam Xie’s tea is indeed fragrant."

He was about to take a sip.

Qiutong, standing beside them, had a cold expression. She pressed the hilt of her sword against Qin Mingheng’s wrist, snatched the teacup, and poured the tea onto the ground.

"Something that this concubine has touched cannot be offered to the Marquis." Yun Chu poured him a new cup and placed it in front of him. "Please, Lord Marquis."

Qin Mingheng’s expression improved slightly.

"Speaking of which, I must thank you, Lord Marquis, for the medicine you bestowed five years ago." Yun Chu continued. "Because of your medicine, my mother-in-law’s health improved greatly. Such kindness, the Xie family will never forget."

At the mention of this, Qin Mingheng’s expression turned ugly again.

That divine medicine had been a treasure passed down through his ancestors, a reward from the imperial family for his ancestors’ protection of the emperor. It had been handed down to him as a family heirloom.

To fulfill his obsession, he had given the medicine to Xie Jingyu. The medicine was given, but what he was supposed to receive in return, he had not...

"Hmph, you’re still thanking the Xie family on their behalf?" Qin Mingheng’s face was icy. "You foolish woman, why don’t you think about why I would give such a rare divine medicine to the Xie family?"

"So—" Yun Chu looked at him steadily, "On our wedding night, it was you, wasn’t it?"

After Xie Shiyou had injured the Marquis Xuande’s heir, Xie Jingyu’s solution had been to take her to the Marquis’s mansion and offer her to Marquis Xuande to avoid disaster.

Therefore, she had reason to suspect that, in order to cure Lady Yuan, Xie Jingyu would be capable of exchanging her for the divine medicine.

Lady Yuan was a life, while she was just a bride on her wedding night... In Xie Jingyu’s eyes, his mother’s life was naturally far more important than her chastity.

This could also explain why, for so many years, Xie Jingyu had never entered her room again; because she had lost her chastity, and he felt she was no longer worthy.

It could also explain why Xie Jingyu had been able to throw away the newborn, still-breathing children, because those two children were not of Xie blood at all.

Yes, even tigers do not eat their own young. No matter how beastly Xie Jingyu was, he wouldn’t have thrown away his own flesh and blood unless they weren’t his.

Yun Chu saw Qin Mingheng’s expression change, and she knew she had guessed correctly.

There was no joy in being right, only a heart filled with coldness.

In her past life, she had been so foolish, so stupid, that she had died without knowing any of this.

She picked up her tea and drank it all in one go before continuing: "How did you know that the bodies I buried were not my children?"

"Because I saw Xie Jingyu throw the children away with my own eyes." Qin Mingheng lowered his gaze. "The children were still alive in his hands when he threw them into the heavy snow."

Yun Chu’s heart tightened: "Where did he throw them?"

"Who can remember clearly?" Qin Mingheng opened his paper fan. "Anyway, it was outside the city, probably south or north... It’s been too long, I really can’t recall."

"Why didn’t you tell me sooner!" Yun Chu exclaimed. "Do you know that those two children were also your own flesh and blood!"

The one who had shared her wedding night was Qin Mingheng, so Qin Mingheng was the biological father of those two children.

He had actually watched Xie Jingyu throw away the two children. Why, why...

"How could I have told you?" Qin Mingheng’s emotions were also somewhat agitated. "I took you by improper means. What face did I have to show you? I was afraid you would look at me with the same eyes you are now, full of disgust... As for you saying those two children were my flesh and blood, on what grounds? Even Xie Jingyu, who sleeps by your side every night, was unwilling to accept the children. On what grounds could you demand that I, an outsider, do so!"

Yun Chu closed her eyes.

She couldn’t tell Qin Mingheng that she and Xie Jingyu had never shared a bed.

Although she had never considered herself pure, she had never imagined she was this filthy.

But she knew it wasn’t her fault.

"Yun Chu, do you know that a long, long time ago, before I was even married, I asked the Yun family for your hand in marriage?" Qin Mingheng propped himself up on the table, his voice low. "But your mother was unwilling to marry you to me. Just as the emperor granted a marriage, I had to turn and marry the Luo family’s daughter. I once sincerely wished for you to find a husband better than me, but I never expected that your mother would marry you to Xie Jingyu! I merely tempted him with a pill, and he agreed. It was he who personally fed you the drug and sent you to the Marquis Xuande’s mansion. You lay on my bed in your wedding dress..."

"Stop!"

Yun Chu suddenly stood up, knocking over her chair.

The people around them who had been watching the cockfight couldn’t help but look over, their eyes filled with suspicion.

Yun Chu paid no attention to them and turned to leave.

She had already gotten the answers she wanted; there was no need to stay any longer.

"Wait!" Qin Mingheng chased after her, following her from the second floor to the first. "Yun Chu, we have shared intimacy, which means we have the reality of husband and wife. No matter how unwilling you are to accept this fact, it has happened. I am willing to take responsibility for that night. Although I am despicable, I am at least more honest than Xie Jingyu. Marry me, and I..."

Before he could finish his sentence, a sweet and gentle voice suddenly rang out: "Lord Marquis, Madam Xie, what are you two talking about?"

Yun Chu looked over and saw Luo Shi, the wife of Marquis Xuande.

As soon as he saw his wife, Qin Mingheng immediately averted his gaze from Yun Chu, taking a few steps back. He looked at his wife and said, "Why are you here?"

"I brought this little one because he insisted on coming to see the cockfight. I let him take a look." Luo Shi pulled the child beside her. "Your father is here, so you can watch with him. I’m really not interested in these things."

Qin Mingheng took his son’s hand and left.

Luo Shi looked at Yun Chu and was about to speak.

Yun Chu curtsied: "Apologies, Madam Marquis. This concubine is feeling unwell and must take my leave."

---

chapters.title: The First Murder
chapters.content:
Yun Chu walked aimlessly through the streets.

The three people with her, Tingshuang and Qiutong, had clearly heard her conversation with Qin Mingheng, and both of their faces were filled with worry.

Especially Qiutong, who had come to the Xie mansion to teach Yun Chu martial arts and had not paid much attention to the inner household affairs. What she had heard today had shattered all her previous understanding.

"Madam, this matter must be told to the Yun family!" Qiutong said in a deep voice. "Xie Jingyu is not a decent man, and Marquis Xuande is not either!"

A servant addressing her master and a nobleman by their given names was a great disrespect, but it was clear that she was too angry to care.

"Tell the Yun family, and then what? Ask the Yun family elders to intervene and divorce?" Yun Chu smiled. "If we divorce, wouldn’t that let the Xie family off too easily?"

Not to mention the impact a divorce would have on the Yun family, even if she agreed, after returning to the Yun family, would she ask her mother and elder brother to take revenge for her?

She was no longer a three-year-old child; she had long passed the age where she would run to her family at the slightest grievance.

However, she would tell her father everything that had happened to the Yun family.

She said softly: "Arrange more people to investigate the snowy night from years ago. No matter how much silver it costs, no matter how much time it takes..."

"Mother!"

Just then, a loud voice rang out.

Even without looking up, Yun Chu knew who it was.

She looked in the direction of the voice and saw Chu Hongyu, dressed in a snow-white brocade robe, running toward her. He threw himself into her arms.

"Mother! Mother!" The little boy’s eyes sparkled. "We are so fated to meet like this!"

Yun Chu gently touched his head and said, "Yu Ge’er, I am not your mother. Don’t call me that anymore."

At first, it had been a little secret between the two of them, but last time at the Yin family, the Yin family members had heard it, and the Prince of Pingxi had heard it too. Now, the group of attendants behind the little boy had also heard it. Once a secret was no longer a secret, more and more people would find out.

Soon after, countless rumors and slander would follow.

There was no need to invite unnecessary trouble.

Chu Hongyu was stunned for a moment, then stood up obediently, pouting as he said, "Aunt Yun, are you still angry about what happened last time?"

"I know I was wrong. I shouldn’t have framed Miss Tan, I shouldn’t have lied, I shouldn’t have run away in a huff, and I shouldn’t have deliberately pushed you, Aunt Yun." The little boy carefully reached out and shook Yun Chu’s sleeve. "Aunt Yun, Father said that as long as I study hard, you will forgive me. These past few days, I have been studying hard. I’ll recite the Hundred Family Names for you: Zhao, Qian, Sun, Li, Zhou..."

He recited it all in one breath, then proudly said, "Because I learn quickly, Father specially allowed me to come out and play. He said that as long as I keep this up, I can have three days a month to go out of the prince’s mansion in the future, and I won’t have to sneak out anymore."

Yun Chu saw that he was not only followed by Ah Mao but also several other attendants, so she knew he must have obtained permission to leave the mansion.

It had been a while since she had seen the little boy. At this moment, when her mood was dark, the child was like a lamp shining into her chest, allowing her to temporarily forget the painful things and have a moment of joy.

She took the little boy’s hand and asked, "What about Changsheng? How is her health lately?"

"A cat was caught and brought back for Changsheng by Father." The little boy chattered on, "Changsheng loves kittens the most, but whenever she touches cat fur, she breaks out in rashes all over, so she can only watch from afar. But she’s still very happy to see the kitten. Changsheng used to stay cooped up in her room and never go out, but with the kitten, she often goes to the courtyard to watch it..."

Yun Chu’s eyes and brows couldn’t help but fill with a smile.

She took the little boy’s hand and strolled down the street, buying a whole box of trinkets. "Half of these are for Changsheng, half are for you, and these few are for the kitten."

"Thank you, Moth... Thank you, Aunt Yun!" Chu Hongyu smiled so much his eyes curved. "Let’s meet again in seven days, okay? I’ll bring Changsheng with me."

He extended his little finger, wanting to make a pinky promise with Yun Chu.

Yun Chu bent down and extended her little finger, hooking it with his.

"Pinky promise, a hundred years no..."

Before she could finish her sentence, suddenly, there was a commotion on the street. The crowd became restless, and there was the sound of horses whinnying.

She looked up and saw that nearly ten people on tall horses had entered the busy market. The riders were moving quickly, knocking over many stalls, and some people were kicked to the ground, rolling in pain. The street instantly fell into chaos.

"Protect the young master!" The guard Ah Mao suddenly shouted, and Chu Hongyu’s attendants rushed forward in a group.

Yu Ke and Qiutong, who had come out with Yun Chu, both had martial arts skills. They immediately stood in front of Yun Chu, and the group crowded around Yun Chu and Chu Hongyu, retreating to the wall of a shop on the side of the street.

They thought they were safe from the horsemen, but unexpectedly, one of the tall horses suddenly stopped in front of them.

The rider on the horse suddenly drew his long sword from his waist and swung it down. Two of the guards who had come out with Chu Hongyu had their blood splattered on the spot and fell to the ground.

Immediately after, two men in black dismounted from their horses and headed straight for Chu Hongyu.

Yun Chu realized that these people were targeting the little boy.

She bent down, picked up the child, and ran away.

Qiutong and Yu Ke protected them as they fled.

Ah Mao led the attendants of the Prince of Pingxi to fend off the black-clad men.

Tingshuang was not skilled in martial arts and was afraid of becoming a burden, so she turned and ran toward the Prince of Pingxi’s mansion. She had to go and send for help quickly.

Yun Chu was a native of the capital and was very familiar with the city. She knew that not far ahead, after turning a corner, was the capital’s Dali Temple.

The Dali Temple was a place for handling cases, with many yamen runners. It would be safe there.

But before they could reach the corner, they heard the sound of galloping hooves behind them.

"Madam, run faster!" Qiutong shouted, turning around to engage the horseman in combat.

Yu Ke had intended to continue protecting Yun Chu and the young master, but when he turned his head, he saw that Qiutong’s shoulder had been slashed by a blade.

The opponent was on horseback, towering above, and there were many of them. Qiutong, a woman, was no match for them. He leaped up, stabbing his blade into the man on the horse. The black-clad man screamed and fell from the horse.

The two of them fought together and managed to hold their own against the group of black-clad men.

Yun Chu ran for her life with the child in her arms. Just as she reached the corner, she heard the sound of hooves.

She thought, *This is bad*, there were more of them ahead.

She had just turned around when a black-clad man appeared behind her. She was caught between the two groups.

Although she had been learning martial arts from Qiutong for a while, she was still only a novice and was no match for them, especially while carrying a child.

"Young Master, blame your father, the Prince of Pingxi, for his ruthlessness! We were forced into a corner too!" the black-clad man said coldly. "Grab them!"

There was no chance for Yun Chu to resist or delay for reinforcements. The black-clad man struck the back of her neck with the hilt of his blade, and she immediately passed out.

chapters.title: Falling into the Hands of Bandits
chapters.content:
Under the night sky.

Five or six bandits gathered around a bonfire, drinking and eating meat, thoroughly enjoying themselves.

Suddenly, several of them sensed something was wrong.

"Why is it so quiet?"

"Could that idiot Old Ba have used too much force and killed the young master of Pingxi?"

"If the young master is dead, we're all doomed!"

The third-in-command spat a thick wad of phlegm, stood up, and walked toward the small wooden hut where the prisoners were held. Four or five others immediately followed.

Yun Chu was just about to sneak out of the hut when she saw five or six men approaching. The only place she could hide was behind the door.

She had just positioned herself behind the door when, *bang!*, the wooden door was kicked open.

"Old Ba and Fatso are dead!" a bandit shouted in alarm. "That woman and the young master are gone! They can't have gone far, hurry, chase after them!"

The bandits turned and ran out.

The third-in-command was about to go search as well when he suddenly paused. Squinting, he looked up at the small window above the door, then at the broken basket rolled into the corner.

That window was big enough for a child to squeeze through, but an adult woman? Impossible!

Realizing this, the third-in-command picked up a knife from the ground and stabbed it through the wooden door.

Yun Chu, hiding behind the door, watched as the blade pierced through, less than an inch from her face.

Immediately after, her hair was grabbed, and she was dragged by the third-in-command and thrown near the bonfire.

The other bandits, who had gone to search, quickly returned.

"Third Boss, we couldn't find the young master!"

"We searched the back room thoroughly, no sign of him!"

"Could he have run into the mountains? It's the middle of the night, and there are wolves up there. If he gets eaten, it's not our fault!"

Yun Chu let out an almost imperceptible sigh of relief.

The third-in-command's gaze darkened as he stared at her. "It's this damn woman who ruined everything for us!"

If he had known, he never would have locked her up with the young master.

But it was too late for regrets now.

"Tell me, how should we kill her?"

The third-in-command looked at Yun Chu as if she were already a corpse.

The other bandits couldn't take their eyes off her. Such a stunning beauty; how could they not stare? Their thoughts were written all over their faces.

Just then, one bandit suddenly spoke up. "I think I've seen this woman before."

The third-in-command scoffed. "Pingxi Wang's woman? You must've seen her in your dreams."

"No, no, no!" The bandit thought hard, then widened his eyes. "Yes, I remember now! Five or six years ago, someone was selling a painting of the most beautiful woman in the capital for a high price. Back then, we had just pulled off a big heist, so I had money and bought that painting. The woman in it, it's her! The most beautiful woman in the capital back then was the legitimate eldest daughter of the Yun family, General Yun, the First Rank Pillars of the State... Third Boss, she's the daughter of a grand general!"

The third-in-command crouched down and grabbed Yun Chu's chin. "Truly deserving of the title 'Most Beautiful Woman in the Capital.' Even if we lost the young master, having the general's eldest daughter in our hands is still a fortune. Trading one of her fingers for thirty thousand taels of silver, would that be too much?"

The bandits, saved from despair, perked up. "Third Boss, before we chop off her fingers, let us brothers have some fun with her. That's not too much to ask, right?"

"Do you think Old Ba and Fatso died for no reason? They died from lust!" Seeing the disappointment on his men's faces, the third-in-command changed his tone. "The general's military power is even more terrifying than Pingxi Wang's. If we ruin the general's daughter, none of us will escape alive. Be gentle!"

"Third Boss, rest assured, we'll be tender with her!"

"Miss Yun, don't be afraid. As long as you cooperate, we won't hurt you!"

"Who goes first?"

The bandits began to discuss among themselves.

Yun Chu lowered her gaze. Since falling into the bandits' den, she had never expected to leave unscathed.

As for her chastity?

She had lost that long ago. What was there to care about?

*Rip!*

Her clothes were torn open by the third-in-command, exposing her shoulder.

At that moment, a fire suddenly flared up in the night. The bandits turned to look.

"The grain storage is on fire!"

"Damn it! I just blew out the lamp when I left; how did it catch fire?"

"Enough talk! Two of you stay here and guard Miss Yun. The rest of you, go put out the fire!"

Yun Chu's eyes snapped open.

That small wooden hut was where she had told Yu Ge'er to hide. The child, seeing her being humiliated, must have started the fire in desperation.

If the bandits went over there, Yu Ge'er would be exposed!

Yun Chu could no longer hesitate. While the two bandits guarding her were distracted by the fire, she quickly reached into the bonfire, pulled out a burning branch, and swung it at the bandits.

"You damn woman, you're asking for death!"

The third-in-command was furious. Drawing his long blade, he swung at Yun Chu's right arm.

If she wouldn't behave, he'd just cut off this troublesome arm and send it to the general's residence!

The burning branch in Yun Chu's hand was sliced in two. She watched helplessly as the blade descended toward her right arm.

Despair filled her heart.

Just then—

An arrow shot through the air.

Before the blade could reach her arm, the arrow pierced through the third-in-command's throat.

The third-in-command didn't even have time to scream. His eyes widened, his body stiffened, blood sprayed out, and then he collapsed to the ground.

As he fell, Yun Chu saw Chu Yi's face.

The man sat atop a tall, powerful horse, bow in hand, his expression sharp and imposing.

After the third-in-command fell, Chu Yi didn't stop. He drew three arrows from his back and loosed them in rapid succession, each striking a bandit in the heart.

He rode his sweating steed toward Yun Chu. Before she could even see his movements clearly, his black cape had already settled over her shoulders, covering her disheveled state.

"Six bandits in total, two more!" Yun Chu shouted, afraid he wouldn't hear her. "The young master is there too!"

Chu Yi nodded and rode toward the wooden hut she pointed at.

The fire raged fiercely, flames engulfing the hut. Yun Chu's heart lodged in her throat.

She wrapped the cape tightly around herself and quickly walked in that direction.

As she approached, she saw two bandits standing by the burning hut, one holding Chu Hongyu, another with a knife in hand and a bow on his back, facing off against Chu Yi.

The collar of Chu Hongyu's clothes was pressed against his neck. The child's face was pale; it was clear he couldn't breathe.

"Pingxi Wang, your son is in our hands!" one bandit shouted, his face filled with fear as he backed away. "If you want to save your son, bring thirty thousand taels of silver to exchange for him!"

Chu Yi narrowed his eyes. "Thirty thousand taels could save countless commoners. Do you really think I would spend it to save one child?"

The two bandits didn't believe him. "If Pingxi Wang is too stubborn, then don't blame us for being ruthless!"

One bandit yanked Chu Hongyu's arm, while the other raised his knife, ready to strike.

*Whoosh!*

An arrow flew through the air.

*Thud!*

It struck one bandit straight in the eye.

Immediately, another arrow shot out, piercing the second bandit's heart.

Chu Hongyu fell to the ground.

Yun Chu rushed forward and scooped the child into her arms. "Yu Ge'er, wake up... Yu Ge'er..."

The child slowly opened his eyes, a smile spreading across his face. "M-Mother... It's good that you're okay..."

Before he could finish, his pupils suddenly dilated. He tried to shout for his mother to run, but his throat seemed to be blocked, no sound came out.

Yun Chu saw in Chu Hongyu's dark pupils a shadow growing larger.

She spun around with the child in her arms.

A sharp pain shot through her side.

---

chapters.title: Big Brother Has a Cape
chapters.content:
After shooting the two bandits, Chu Yi dismounted and walked toward his son.

Unexpectedly, someone had already beaten him to it, Yun Chu was holding Chu Hongyu.

Seeing the woman holding his son, Chu Yi vaguely felt that Chu Hongyu's features bore some resemblance to her.

Wait... Changsheng and Lady Xie looked even more alike, same eyes, nose, mouth... as if carved from the same mold...

A wild thought crossed Chu Yi's mind. Could it be...

Just as he was lost in thought, the bandit with an arrow in his eye suddenly grabbed a nearby long blade and swung it at Yun Chu.

Yun Chu spun swiftly, but she couldn't dodge in time. The blade slashed across her waist. The bandit, as if possessed, continued to hack wildly.

Chu Yi's expression darkened. With a powerful kick, he knocked the bandit down, then picked up the blade and slit the bandit's throat.

The wound on the bandit's neck quickly turned black.

"Lady Xie, this blade is poisoned!" Chu Yi exclaimed.

He scooped up his stunned son and handed him to a nearby guard. Then he turned to Yun Chu. "Lady Xie, forgive me."

Before Yun Chu could understand what was happening, the man had already picked her up horizontally and carried her into the nearby unburned wooden hut.

If she didn't know him well enough to trust that he wasn't that kind of man, she would have already drawn a hairpin to stab him.

"Lady Xie, that blade had a deadly poison," Chu Yi said bluntly. "There's no doctor on this mountain. I'll help you suck out the poison first, then we'll go down the mountain for treatment."

Yun Chu immediately lifted the cape.

Her waist was torn open, revealing a long, bloody gash. The flesh seemed tainted with black ink, making her heart tremble.

She hadn't felt much pain from the wound at first, but seeing the gruesome injury, her entire body began to weaken.

She had only been reborn for a little over two months. There were still so many things she hadn't done; how could she die like this?

"Your Highness is of royal blood, noble and supreme. I cannot let this poison harm Your Highness's body," Yun Chu said. "Please, Your Highness, just find anyone else to do it."

This body of hers had already been ruined on her wedding night. Chastity, purity, these things meant nothing to her.

Chu Yi saw the defeat in her eyes.

She probably didn't care about her chastity because there was no need to...

He had heard that Minister Xie and Lady Xie were deeply in love, their marriage a model of devotion. How could she be so indifferent to her own virtue?

But now was not the time for such thoughts. Chu Yi spoke, "Lady Xie risked her life to protect my son. Helping you remove the poison is the least I can do to repay this lifesaving debt."

With that, he leaned down.

Yun Chu instinctively flinched.

A woman's chastity was a cage, trapping women within it. Even if she didn't care, she couldn't ignore the instinctive resistance in her heart.

"Lady Xie, don't be afraid."

The man's large hand pressed against her waist. Then, a soft, scorching sensation spread from her waist to her limbs.

She closed her eyes, commanding herself to stay calm.

To survive, she had to get the poison out quickly. Otherwise, by the time they got down the mountain, it might be too late.

Just pretend... pretend the man in front of her was just some random guard. Pretend she didn't know him. Then it wouldn't be so hard to face.

Her mind began to recall the events of her past life, one by one, over and over... Finally, the sensation at her waist disappeared.

Yun Chu opened her eyes and met Chu Yi's gaze. His lips had turned black.

"Lady Xie, there's not much poison left. You're out of danger," Chu Yi said after rinsing his mouth three times. "What happened today, only you and I know. Please..."

*Bang!*

Before he could finish, the door was kicked open.

"Chu'er!"

Yun Ze rushed in, his face filled with panic. But when he saw the scene inside, he froze.

Pingxi Wang and Chu'er were alone together in a room, that was bad enough. But Chu'er's clothes were disheveled, her waist exposed. If not for the gruesome wound on her skin, he might have misunderstood the situation.

He saw Pingxi Wang's blackened lips and the black poisonous liquid on the ground. He immediately understood what had happened.

Yun Chu quickly grabbed the cape and wrapped it around herself.

Even being seen like this by her own brother made her uncomfortable.

Yun Ze maintained his composure as he walked in and cupped his hands. "Many thanks to Your Highness for saving my sister's life. The Yun family will never forget this kindness."

"It was Lady Xie who saved my son. This was the least I could do," Pingxi Wang said indifferently. "Minister Yun, don't delay any longer. Take Lady Xie down the mountain for treatment. I happen to know a female physician, I can send someone to fetch her to treat Lady Xie's injuries."

"I also happen to know that physician. There's no need to trouble Your Highness."

Yun Ze walked to Yun Chu's side and tried to remove the cape wrapped tightly around her.

Yun Chu didn't know what he was doing and held on tightly.

Yun Ze lowered his voice. "Your big brother also has a cape."

Yun Chu's expression turned awkward, and she loosened her grip.

Yun Ze pulled off the cape and quickly draped his own outer robe over Yun Chu. Only then did he turn to Pingxi Wang. "Thank you, Your Highness."

Chu Yi took back his cape. Apart from the smell of blood, there was a faint, familiar scent, one that belonged to a woman.

He had smelled it earlier when he was removing the poison from her. A very familiar fragrance...

Yun Ze carried Yun Chu out.

Outside, a soft sedan chair was waiting. She was carefully placed inside.

The people from Pingxi Wang's residence and the Yun family quickly descended the mountain.

At the foot of the mountain, Yun Ze cupped his hands to Chu Yi, and the two groups went their separate ways.

Chu Hongyu, weak and leaning against Chu Yi, stared intently at the Yun family's carriage. "Father, why aren't we taking Mother back to the prince's residence for treatment?"

"She's not your mother," Chu Yi said. "She is Lady Xie of the Yun family. She can go to the Yun residence or the Xie residence, but she cannot go to the prince's residence."

"But the man she married, Xie what's-his-name, isn't good to her at all. I heard the Xie family servants say that all these years, that Xie man never once visited her room..." The boy bit his lip. "That man must not like her, must not like Aunt Yun at all. Aunt Yun must have had a very hard time..."

Chu Yi's expression darkened.

Everyone said the Xie couple were deeply in love. Could the rumors be untrue?

---

Yun Chu was taken directly to the Yun residence by Yun Ze. A famous female physician from the capital was summoned to clean her wound, apply medicine, and bandage her waist.

After taking her medicine, Yun Chu fell asleep. She didn't wake up until the sun was high in the sky.

Ling Feng and Ling Xue attended to her as she drank her medicine.

Just as she finished, her sister-in-law, Liu Qianqian, entered with a smile. "Last night, your big brother went to the Xie residence and said your carriage had an accident and you were injured. You'll stay here at the Yun residence to recover for a few days."

Yun Chu nodded. Ever since learning the truth about her wedding night, she indeed didn't want to return to the Xie residence for the time being.

"That..." Liu Qianqian coughed and began, "For us women, chastity is important, but in the face of life, chastity is worthless. Whatever happened last night, don't take it to heart."

Yun Chu let out a soft laugh.

To comfort her, her well-educated sister-in-law had actually used such coarse language.

Actually, after sleeping through the night, the events of yesterday seemed almost forgotten.

chapters.title: Not Uncle Yun
chapters.content:
Yun Chu felt drowsy after taking the medicine.

Liu Qianqian walked out of the room.

Seeing her come out, Yun Ze, who had been waiting in the courtyard, immediately approached: "Has Chu'er come to her senses?"

"Not at all, husband," Liu Qianqian said. "I think Chu'er never took that matter to heart. Do you believe that if a woman is too intimate with a man other than her husband, it’s a grave mistake? Men can have three wives and four concubines, can go a year without entering their wife’s room. Chu'er did it to survive, she had no choice but to cooperate with Prince Pingxi. Even if something really happened, I don’t think she has wronged the Xie family."

Yun Ze was stunned.

His wife had always been gentle, virtuous, and reasonable. He never expected to hear such words from her.

Wait!

He asked, "Madam, do you mean that Xie Jingyu hasn’t entered Chu'er’s room for a year?"

Liu Qianqian nodded coldly.

Recently, her mother-in-law had accompanied Chu'er to see a divine doctor. After returning, her mother-in-law had been in low spirits. Only then did she learn that Chu'er and her husband had not shared a bed for at least a year.

Chu'er had worked tirelessly for the Xie family, raising so many illegitimate children. How dare Xie Jingyu, as her husband, humiliate his lawful wife like this!

Yun Ze’s expression was no better.

It was natural for men to take concubines, of course, he hadn’t taken any, but that didn’t mean he wasn’t a man. He just didn’t see the need.

No matter how many concubines a man had in his household, he should never neglect his wife. Otherwise, what was the difference between that and favoring concubines over one’s wife?

"Husband," Liu Qianqian said slowly, "Chu'er is injured this time, so let her stay here a little longer. Let Xie Jingyu realize that without Chu'er, without the Yun family, the Xie family is nothing."

Yun Ze nodded. "As you say."

Just as the couple was speaking, a servant came to report: "Master, Madam, the young master-in-law has arrived."

The young master-in-law of the Yun family was naturally Xie Jingyu.

Yun Ze originally wanted to tell Xie Jingyu to leave, but then he thought of something and said, "Take him to the study."

Xie Jingyu did not come alone; he had brought Xie Shian with him.

Although the two families were related by marriage, the Xie family rarely visited the Yun family, except for festivals and banquets.

The father and son waited in the study for a long time. The servants didn’t even bring tea. After about a quarter of an hour, Yun Ze finally arrived.

"Sorry to have kept you waiting, brother-in-law," Yun Ze said with a smile, showing no sign of deliberate difficulty. "Why is Shian here? No classes at the academy today?"

Xie Shian stood up: "I was worried about my mother’s injury, so I took leave to see her."

"You are indeed a filial child," Yun Ze said. "Your mother just fell asleep. It’s better not to disturb her rest. Jiang Ge has been very eager to study lately. Shian, since you passed the imperial examination at such a young age, let Jiang Ge learn from you."

Xie Shian nodded and turned to leave the study.

Yun Ze’s smile disappeared. "Brother-in-law, what kind of tea would you like? I’ll have someone bring it."

Xie Jingyu’s expression was extremely pale. "No need. I’ll wait here for Madam to wake up and take her home."

In terms of official rank, he was fifth-grade, while Yun Ze was seventh-grade. Even if Yun Ze couldn’t bow to him, he should at least show proper respect.

But he couldn’t see any respect on Yun Ze’s face. It was as if he wasn’t being taken seriously at all.

"Whether Chu'er returns to the Xie family or not, we can discuss later," Yun Ze said coldly. "Brother-in-law, since you became the future father-in-law of Prince Anjing, your social engagements seem to have increased a lot. I’ve heard that you’ve received many fine gifts lately, such as a coral basin, a jade ruyi, and even someone directly gave you silver."

Xie Jingyu’s expression changed abruptly. "Where did you hear this from, Elder Brother?"

"I am her husband, so naturally I pay more attention to you. I casually chatted with a few officials from the Ministry of Revenue and found out all this," Yun Ze shook his head. "If someone deliberately targets you and thoroughly investigates you from top to bottom, and these things are handed over to the Censorate, do you know what the consequences would be?"

Xie Jingyu clenched his fists tightly.

In the imperial court, everyone did this, accepting gifts before handling matters. It was an unwritten rule. Why couldn’t it apply to him?

"It doesn’t matter what others do!" Yun Ze’s voice grew colder. "If your actions tarnish the century-old reputation of the Yun family, the first thing the Yun family will do is make Chu'er divorce you!"

Xie Jingyu’s face darkened, but he quickly concealed his expression, cupped his hands, and said, "Elder Brother is right. I won’t do it again in the future."

"There will be no future." Yun Ze shook his head. "Return all the things you’ve accepted before. Only when they are all returned will Chu'er return to the Xie family! Lord Xie, goodbye, I won’t see you out."

With that, he turned and left.

Xie Jingyu picked up the teacup from the table, intending to smash it on the ground, but then realized he was in the Yun family’s residence and had to suppress his anger.

He walked out of the study and met up with Xie Shian. Xie Shian asked, "Father, why do you look so ugly? Did Uncle say something to you?"

Xie Jingyu said in a deep voice, "After the emperor issued the decree for the marriage, many people sent gifts to ask me for favors. I refused at first, but it caused quite a scene. Later, I accepted some, but your uncle found out. He said I was damaging the Yun family’s reputation and ordered me to return everything I had received."

Xie Shian spoke up, "Uncle is not wrong. If Father wants to climb higher, he must be more careful in this regard. Return what needs to be returned."

Xie Jingyu pursed his lips. "Those things have already been recorded on Pin Jie’er’s dowry list..."

"Father need not worry about the dowry," Xie Shian said after some thought. "Wait until Mother recovers from her injuries. Let Mother find a way."

As the father and son spoke, they slowly reached the main gate of the Yun residence. Just as they were about to get into the carriage, another carriage stopped.

Before the carriage had even come to a complete stop, a child in brocade clothes jumped out and ran into the Yun residence.

Following that, a man stepped out of the carriage, exuding an imposing and formidable presence.

At just a glance, Xie Jingyu immediately pulled Xie Shian to bow. "This official greets Prince Pingxi. Wishing the Prince good health."

Chu Yi’s gaze fell on Xie Jingyu. He recognized him as the husband of that woman, a fifth-grade official in the Ministry of Revenue.

And the one beside him should be her legitimate eldest son.

He only glanced at them before striding into the Yun residence.

Xie Jingyu lifted his head and watched as the guards respectfully escorted Chu Yi inside. His emotions were extremely complicated.

His father-in-law was not in the capital, and the Yun family only had Yun Ze, a mere seventh-grade official, yet he could make a prince visit in person. No wonder Yun Ze dared to lecture him like that.

Yun Ze had just sent Xie Jingyu away when a servant reported that Prince Pingxi and the young master had arrived.

Without delay, he went to the study and had the best tea and refreshments served.

Before he could speak, Chu Hongyu urgently said, "Uncle Yun, uh—"

His mouth was covered. Chu Yi coldly said, "Call him Lord Yun."

After the boy nodded, Chu Yi released his hand. Chu Hongyu corrected himself, "Lord Yun, how is Aunt Yun’s injury? Can I see Aunt Yun?"

---

chapters.title: A Rare Sweetness in Life
chapters.content:
Yun Chu woke up after a short nap.

Opening her eyes, she saw a small face enlarged in front of her.

"Auntie, you’re awake."

Chu Hongyu was leaning on the edge of the bed, looking very well-behaved.

"Young Master insisted on coming in to watch you sleep," Liu Qianqian said helplessly, lowering her head. "Young Master, can we go out now?"

Chu Hongyu shook his head like a rattle drum. "Auntie would be so bored alone. Can I stay and tell Auntie a story?"

Yun Chu propped herself up slightly and touched his body. "Weren’t you scared last night?"

"With Auntie protecting me, nothing happened to me!" The little guy patted his chest, then sighed. "Father King says a real man should protect women, but I’m too small to protect you. But don’t worry, Auntie. When I grow up, if anyone dares to bully you, I’ll pay them back tenfold!"

He secretly glanced at Liu Qianqian beside him, then leaned close to Yun Chu’s ear and whispered, "When I grow up, I’ll marry you back home in Father King’s place. Then I can openly call you Mother!"

Yun Chu: "..."

She gently patted the child’s head. "Then Auntie thanks you in advance."

Liu Qianqian sighed in her heart. The child and Chu’er looked so close. If someone who didn’t know saw them, they might think they were mother and son.

"Auntie, I read a very interesting story in a book yesterday. Let me tell you," the little guy said. "The book says there was a child who was very smart and could learn anything. His father was very proud..."

As he spoke, he climbed onto Yun Chu’s bed.

It was the middle of summer, and Yun Chu only had a thin blanket over her. The little guy didn’t seem to mind the heat and snuggled under the blanket in Yun Chu’s arms, telling the story with great relish.

Yun Chu’s serious injury had not yet healed. Although she had just woken up from a nap, after talking for a while, her head began to feel heavy again.

Tingshuang brought in the freshly decocted medicine, ready to help her drink it.

Chu Hongyu climbed off the bed. "I’ll do it, I’ll do it! Can I feed Auntie the medicine?"

He scooped up the medicine with a spoon, blew on it, then blew again before slowly bringing it to Yun Chu’s lips.

Yun Chu drank it and smiled. "Thank you, Yu Ge."

Chu Hongyu was small, but once he set his mind to doing something, he would do it well. He carefully fed her the entire bowl of medicine.

After finishing, he quickly asked Tingshuang, "Where are the candied fruits?"

Tingshuang lowered her head. "Madam doesn’t like very sweet things. We didn’t prepare any candied fruits."

"That won’t do," the little guy frowned. "Medicine is so bitter. If you don’t eat something sweet afterward, the bitter taste stays in your mouth all day. It’s terrible..."

He felt his body and said, "When I left, the wet nurse gave me honey dates. Auntie, open your mouth. Ah—"

Although Yun Chu didn’t like sweets, she couldn’t refuse the child’s good intentions. She opened her mouth, and a honey date was placed inside.

The sweetness filled her mouth, and her heart seemed to be soaked in honey, sweet and warm.

Life was too bitter. She was reluctant to swallow this sweetness.

"Auntie, after taking medicine, you need to rest well. I’ll leave now," Chu Hongyu said, jumping off the couch and standing obediently by the bed. "Tomorrow, I’ll bring Changsheng to see Auntie."

Liu Qianqian was surprised.

So, the young lady of Prince Pingxi’s residence also had a good relationship with Chu’er?

Chu’er spent all her time in the Xie family’s inner quarters. How did she have the chance to get so close to the young master and young lady?

Outside, Chu Hongyu obediently walked to Chu Yi’s side. "Father King, Aunt Yun is resting. Let’s go back."

Chu Yi felt for the first time that his son was sensible.

He had thought the boy would insist on staying at the Yun residence and had even prepared to use force to take him back...

"Father King, Auntie asked about Changsheng. Let’s bring Changsheng tomorrow."

Chu Yi pinched the space between his eyebrows.

They had agreed to only come once. Who said anything about coming again tomorrow?

Although Lady Xie had saved his son, frequent visits were not appropriate. There were many other ways to express gratitude besides visiting.

As a man, if he kept bringing his son to visit another family’s lady, if word got out, it wouldn’t affect him, but it would affect Lady Xie. His rash actions had already caused trouble for Lady Xie. If he came every day, she might suspect he had some...

Thinking of this, Chu Yi’s mind conjured up the image of that slender waist, so delicate it seemed it could be encircled with one hand.

When he realized what he was thinking, his ears couldn’t help but turn red. He coughed and said with a calm expression, "Lord Yun, Lady Yun, this prince will take his leave."

Yun Ze nodded and personally saw them out.

As they walked outside, a carriage stopped at the gate of the Yun residence.

Yun Ze frowned. His father was not in the capital, and the Yun family rarely had visitors. Why were they coming one after another today?

He glanced at the carriage and recognized it as belonging to the Marquis of Xuanwu.

Qin Mingheng had heard that the Yun residence had called for a female doctor in the middle of the night to treat an illness. Early that morning, he had specially invited a female doctor to the marquis’s residence to check on his wife’s pulse. Only then did he learn that Yun Chu had been injured in a carriage accident and was recovering at the Yun residence.

He was somewhat worried, so he came to the Yun residence to inquire about the news.

Who would have thought that as soon as he got out of the carriage, he would run into Prince Pingxi?

He was a marquis without real power, and in front of a prince personally bestowed by the emperor, he was nothing. He immediately bowed his head. "This official greets the Prince."

Chu Yi stared at him coldly.

Over the past few years, he had been very busy, first, running around to cure his two children, and second, following orders to suppress bandits in various places. He had been away from the capital for a long time.

Recently, he had finally been able to stay in the capital for an extended period. He had tried to meet with Marquis Xuanwu for tea many times, but the marquis had always avoided him.

He had been preparing to force the marquis into the prince’s residence when he unexpectedly ran into him at the Yun residence’s gate. This was a good opportunity.

"Last time I invited Marquis Xuanwu for tea, he said he was ill. But this prince sees that he looks in good spirits," Chu Yi said. "Coincidentally, there are some things I need to ask Marquis Xuanwu."

Qin Mingheng lowered his head and tightened his grip on the paper fan.

Five years ago, after the incident, Prince Pingxi had asked him once.

After the two children were born, Prince Pingxi had questioned him again.

He hadn’t expected that after so many years, he would still be asked!

He followed Chu Yi to the large stone lion in front of the Yun residence’s gate. "Your Highness, this official has already said before that the woman went into hiding after being dishonored five years ago. It wasn’t until she went into premature labor that I learned of her whereabouts. By the time I arrived, she had already died from a difficult birth, and the two children had also stopped breathing... I thought the children were dead, so I didn’t dare to send them to the prince’s residence. That’s why I left them on the path Your Highness was sure to take... If Your Highness doesn’t believe me, you can send someone to investigate."

He still couldn’t believe that two premature babies, who had been on the verge of death, had been saved!

He would never tell Chu Yi that the woman back then was the eldest daughter of the Yun family!

If he couldn’t have her, no one else could!

Chu Yi’s lips were icy cold.

If he could find out the truth, he wouldn’t have to ask.

He spoke, "This prince wants to ask Marquis Xuanwu, did that woman have any other family?"

The imperial physician said that Changsheng’s illness required the company of a relative. Perhaps one day, he would start speaking. But their mother was already dead. Even with his immense power, there was nothing he could do.

In the royal family, familial affection was too ethereal.

He had long wanted to find the children’s maternal relatives, but he had been too busy suppressing bandits to break away. Now, he had finally cornered Marquis Xuanwu.

That woman had died in childbirth. Over the years, he had always had a knot in his heart. If he could find her family, he would treat them well...

chapters.title: They Look Too Alike
chapters.content:
"She has no family."

Qin Mingheng lowered his head, his face dark and sinister.

"She is a lowly servant girl bought by the Qin family, with no father or mother. Your Highness, please stop thinking about her."

After saying this, he cupped his hands and retreated a few steps, then turned and walked towards Yun Ze, following him into the Yun family's main gate.

Chu Yi tightened his thin lips.

Five years ago, he had followed the pillar country's grand general back to the capital to report for duty. That day happened to be the day of the general's eldest daughter, Yun Chu's, wedding.

General Yun was overjoyed and kept pulling him to drink. He had followed along and drunk a lot of nu'erhong wine, but was drugged by a concubine's daughter from a third-rank official's family when he let his guard down.

That concubine's daughter had pulled him into a side room of the Yun family, and he had cut off her restless hand on the spot.

After leaving the Yun family, the effects of the drug became stronger and stronger. Later, he lost consciousness... When he woke up, his subordinates told him that he had collapsed at the back gate of the Marquis Wu's mansion. His subordinates had no choice but to take him into the Marquis Wu's mansion and find a clean servant girl to help him relieve the drug's effects...

He was not an irresponsible man, so he ordered his subordinates to bring that girl back to the prince's mansion, and he would give her the position of a concubine.

But Marquis Wu said that the girl could not bear the humiliation, escaped from the mansion, and disappeared without a trace.

It wasn't until about seven months later, on the way back to the capital, that he saw two children in the snow.

The two children were only as big as his palm, their bodies purple and blue, as if they had even stopped breathing. When he placed his hand on their hearts, he could only feel a weak heartbeat. He immediately ordered someone to find an imperial physician to treat the children.

While treating the children, his old nanny, who had served him since he was young, muttered that the boy looked exactly like him when he was young, even with a mole on the sole of his foot...

He had someone bring a basin of clear water and performed a blood test to confirm their relationship.

Sure enough, these two children were his!

He immediately went to find Marquis Wu and only then learned that after that night, the woman had become pregnant. Because it was twins, she had a premature and difficult birth, bleeding non-stop, and passed away.

The two children were born two months early and could barely breathe, let alone drink milk...

Now, recalling it, he didn't know how he had managed to raise the two children to this age, but he still hadn't raised them well. Yu'er was willful and disobedient, and Changsheng was weak and mute...

"Father?"

Chu Hongyu poked his head out of the carriage and called out.

Chu Yi snapped out of his memories and got into the carriage.

Perhaps because he had just thought of how the children looked when they were born, and then recalled the dangerous scene from last night, a hint of fear arose in him. He said, "Yu'er, it was my fault that you were kidnapped by bandits. As your father, I apologize to you."

Chu Hongyu raised his bright eyes: "I am the young master of the Pingxi Prince's mansion. Everything I eat, use, and live in belongs to Father. Having enjoyed these, I naturally should bear the dangers that come with this identity. So, Father, there's no need to apologize."

Chu Yi rubbed his head.

Although his son was willful, he understood the important principles, which was already reassuring.

Yun Chu's body had improved a lot by the third day.

Although the injured area still hurt a bit, at least she was no longer in a daze.

The women of the Yun family were all sitting in her room, keeping her company and chatting to relieve her boredom: her mother, Lin Shi, her sister-in-law, Liu Qianqian, and her half-sister, Yun Ran.

Yun Chu's father, Yun Silin, had only one concubine, who had given birth to only one illegitimate daughter. In this generation, there were only three siblings: Yun Ze, Yun Chu, and Yun Ran.

Yun Ze and Liu Qianqian had known each other since they were young, and the couple lived in harmony without any concubines or mistresses. In these years, they had only one legitimate son, Jiang Ge'er.

Yun Chu sighed. Because the Yun family had few people and simple relationships, there was not much scheming, so her mother had become more and more naive, always looking at things superficially. Therefore, in her previous life, both her and Yun Ran's marriages had gone wrong...

"You child, why are you sighing?" Lin Shi said with a smile, "Today happens to be three months, let me tell you some good news."

Yun Chu suppressed her thoughts and cooperated, "What good news?"

"Your sister-in-law, she's pregnant." Lin Shi's face was full of smiles, "Probably due next spring."

"Congratulations to my elder brother and sister-in-law!" Yun Ran also became excited, "Jiang Ge'er will finally have a younger brother or sister."

Yun Chu's fingers suddenly stiffened.

No wonder she hadn't remembered that her sister-in-law was pregnant; because in this life, the child had not been kept.

Although the Yun family's main branch had simple relationships, as a century-old family, the collateral branches were countless. The child in her sister-in-law's belly had been... by a collateral branch. However, at that time, she was not in the capital, so she didn't know exactly what had happened.

"Chu'er..."

Liu Qianqian keenly noticed Yun Chu's expression and secretly tugged at Lin Shi's clothes.

It was difficult for Chu'er to get pregnant, and she had unexpectedly become pregnant. Afraid that Chu'er would feel uncomfortable, she had not dared to say it.

She hadn't expected her mother-in-law to blurt it out so casually.

Although Chu'er would find out sooner or later, she had thought to hide it for as long as possible...

"Congratulations, Sister-in-law!" Yun Chu forced a smile, reaching out to touch Liu Qianqian's belly, "This child will definitely be born safely and smoothly."

Liu Qianqian changed the subject: "Chu'er, you mentioned opening a shop in the summer resort courtyard last time. That idea was brilliant. The shop has only been open for half a month and has already earned four or five hundred taels of silver, and that's without putting much effort into it."

Yun Chu had heard from Chen Defu that a small sundry shop had been opened in the summer resort courtyard, selling everyday items that common people needed, such as pots, bowls, salt, and ironware. The purpose of opening the shop was not to make money, so the prices were not high and were kept at the same level as the market. However, because common people came here every afternoon to escape the heat, with so many people coming and going, there would always be a few who would take out some coins to buy things. It didn't matter where they bought them.

Lin Shi spoke up: "Your sister-in-law means to expand the shop a bit more. Since it can make money, we should manage it well."

Yun Chu nodded: "It's the common people who support us, so we should sell more things that they need."

The group discussed some details, and Liu Qianqian wrote them down, ordering the servants to start working on them.

"Chu'er, stay at the Yun family for a few more days." Lin Shi said, "In a few more days, the Dai family will send their betrothal gifts. You can watch the excitement before going back."

At the mention of the Dai family, Yun Ran's face turned completely red, and she didn't know where to put her hands.

Yun Chu naturally agreed.

As they were talking, a maid reported at the door: "Madam, the Prince of Pingxi has arrived. The eldest young master is currently keeping him company with tea. The young master and the princess want to see the eldest miss."

Lin Shi had seen Chu Hongyu the day before and liked him very much. Hearing this, she said, "Quickly bring the young master and the princess over."

The two children immediately appeared from behind the maid.

"Madam Yun, Aunt Yun, Aunt Liu, I've brought my sister!"

Chu Hongyu pulled Chu Changsheng and skipped into the room.

He had asked A Mao what his mother's mother was called, and A Mao said she was called grandmother. He was afraid that calling her grandmother would make Madam Yun uncomfortable, so he called her Madam Yun instead.

"Little Young Master is so well-behaved." Lin Shi pulled the two children over, her gaze falling on Chu Changsheng's face, "Heavens, the little princess is too thin, all bones..."

As she spoke, she suddenly paused.

If the little princess had a bit more flesh on her face, she would look just like Chu'er when she was young. They looked too alike!

---

chapters.title: You May Slowly Return
chapters.content:
Yun Chu touched the little girl's face; she was indeed too thin.

The little girl nestled into her arms, and Chu Hongyu said from the side: "Changsheng, Aunt Yun is injured here. Be careful not to touch it."

The little girl nodded obediently, shifted her body down a bit, puckered her lips, and blew on Yun Chu's injured spot.

Yun Chu's heart melted completely.

"Qianqian, have you noticed? The little princess looks a lot like Yun Chu." Lin Shi lowered her voice, "Especially the eyes."

Liu Qianqian looked over and was also startled: "It's true, they do look a bit alike. But perhaps this is just the fate between Chu'er and the little princess and young master."

It was rare for these two children to be close to Chu'er, and Chu'er also liked them very much. Such a connection was hard to come by.

"I heard that the marriage between the second miss of the Tan family and the Prince of Pingxi didn't work out." Lin Shi's voice was extremely low, "Madam Tan is a gentle woman, so the second miss of the Tan family should also be good. It will be difficult for the Prince of Pingxi to find a more suitable princess consort than the second miss of the Tan family."

Liu Qianqian nodded.

This second miss of the Tan family was probably carefully selected by Consort Yin. Unfortunately, she didn't catch the Prince of Pingxi's eye.

For the next few days, Chu Hongyu and Chu Changsheng would come to the Yun family. At first, the Prince of Pingxi came with them, but later, he only sent servants to follow.

The two children had no restraints. After coming to the Yun family in the morning, they would only leave in the evening. If they weren't afraid of making their father angry, Chu Hongyu would have wanted to stay overnight at the Yun family with his sister.

Xie Jingyu would come every other day, but he was always refused entry by Yun Ze.

Days passed one by one, and soon it was the day for the Dai family to send their betrothal gifts. In the capital, the custom was to send betrothal gifts one month before the wedding.

Watching the betrothal gifts being carried in one by one, Yun Chu couldn't help but sigh at how fast time passed. It had been the end of March when she was reborn, and now it was already July.

She saw Yun Ran and the young master of the Dai family gazing at each other from across the crowd, both of their faces flushed, and she couldn't help but smile.

At this moment, however, she heard a discordant voice.

"Why did my sister-in-law find such a marriage for Sister Ran? He's only a fifth-rank official; the family status is too low."

Yun Chu looked over and saw a woman from the Yun family's collateral branch, dressed in pearls and jewels. She called this woman Third Aunt. This aunt's husband was her father's third cousin.

Third Aunt was still muttering: "I don't know what my sister-in-law was thinking. Back then, when she married Sister Chu to the Xie family, at least Xie Jingyu was a zhuangyuan, which was a good catch. But this Second Young Master Dai is only a xiucai. How is he worthy of a Yun family's precious daughter?"

Another woman sighed: "Our Yun family relies on those military merits to support itself. Among the younger generation, no one has joined the military. I don't know who will be able to support the Yun family's reputation in the future."

Third Aunt shook her head: "Ze'er is the eldest legitimate son of the family, and he's already in his twenties, but he's only a seventh-rank official in the court. He really can't support the Yun family... He's not as good as our Run'er..."

She didn't dare say this loudly, only muttering softly.

Her son, Yun Run, had also passed the imperial examination and become a jinshi. Initially, he was an insignificant ninth-rank official.

Later, she found a good marriage for her son. With the Yun family's influence, it wasn't too difficult to marry into a third-rank family. After much mediation, it was settled. After the marriage, with his father-in-law's help, Run'er was now a fifth-rank official in the court. If he was lucky, he might be promoted to the fourth rank by the end of the year... Wasn't he much stronger than Yun Ze?

In marriage matters, it was like a ladder. Whether the ladder went up or down depended entirely on the judgment of the mistress of the house.

In her opinion, her sister-in-law's mind was still too shallow...

Yun Chu glanced over and withdrew her gaze.

The Yun family's collateral branches were numerous and complex. Each person had their own thoughts. As long as these collateral branches didn't make major mistakes or affect the Yun family's reputation, even the Yun family's elders wouldn't interfere with their choices.

On the day the Dai family sent their betrothal gifts, there was no need for a grand banquet. Only the closest relatives were invited to eat a meal together and bear witness.

The Xie family was a relative by marriage and shouldn't have come, but Xie Jingyu still visited.

This was the first time Xie Jingyu had seen Yun Chu in about half a month. After so many years of marriage, this was the first time they had been separated for such a long time.

"Madam, you look much better." He had a gentle and refined smile on his face, "When the flowers bloom on the path, you may slowly return."

Yun Chu smiled.

Such romantic and beautiful words, when spoken by Xie Jingyu, completely lacked that feeling.

However, having been away for so long, it was indeed time to go back.

She nodded: "Alright."

Yun Chu bade farewell to each of her family members.

Lin Shi was very reluctant, but she also knew that for a married daughter to stay at her parents' home for half a month was already rare. Staying any longer would affect her marital relationship.

Although she had gradually begun to despise Xie Jingyu as her son-in-law, Chu'er clearly still wanted to continue the marriage, so she respected Chu'er's choice.

Under the gaze of the Yun family, Yun Chu, supported by Qiutong's hand, got into the carriage.

As the carriage curtain fell, she saw Tingshuang standing below, looking at a person at the steps of the Yun family's mansion. It was Yu Ke.

Yun Chu's lips couldn't help but curve into a smile.

As soon as she sat down in the carriage, Xie Jingyu got in as well.

He looked at Yun Chu's profile and said slowly, "Madam, do you know what has happened these days?"

Yun Chu turned her head, looking as if she was all ears.

"My official rank has been demoted by one level." Xie Jingyu stared at her, "Just because you stayed at your parents' home for a long time, my official rank was demoted."

In the entire capital, no woman, not even a princess, had a reason to stay at her parents' home for so long after marriage, unless she didn't plan to continue the marriage.

Yun Chu had stayed at the Yun family for half a month, and countless rumors had spread through the capital, all saying that the Yun family was preparing for a divorce.

Originally, he didn't care about these rumors, but the people in the court were used to trimming their sails according to the wind, flattering the powerful and belittling the weak. They had actually set a trap for him. He had carelessly fallen into it, made a big mistake, and the Minister of Revenue was furious. His superior, Mr. Yu, was penalized with a year's salary, and his own rank was directly demoted from the fifth rank upper to the fifth rank lower.

He didn't understand. Even if he and Yun Chu really divorced, he would still be the father-in-law of the future Fourth Prince.

As the father-in-law of a prince, compared to being the son-in-law of the Yun family, shouldn't that be more noble and make those people more fearful of him?

"Oh, that's interesting." Yun Chu's lips curled into a sneer, "So, according to you, whether you get promoted or demoted depends on me, a mere woman?"

These words made Xie Jingyu almost unable to lift his head.

Yun Chu might as well have said outright that he was relying on a woman.

Clearly, it was he himself who had studied hard for more than a decade, passed the imperial examination from xiucai all the way to zhuangyuan, and established himself in the court... He admitted that the rapid promotion was partly due to the Yun family, but it was mostly due to his own efforts.

He just couldn't accept that, after reaching the fifth rank, his rank was demoted by half a level just because Yun Chu had stayed at her parents' home for a short time. Why!

Yun Chu twitched the corner of her mouth.

If he couldn't bear a demotion of half a level, how would he be able to bear what was about to happen in the future.

chapters.title: Who Doesn’t Follow the Rules
chapters.content:
The carriage stopped at the entrance of the Xie residence.

Yun Chu had been away from the Xie family for half a month. After returning home, she naturally went to pay her respects to the old madam.

The old madam had been ill before, and after a period of rest, she had recovered quite a bit. She was leaning on a couch, and there were no ice blocks in the room.

It wasn’t that they couldn’t afford it. Even if the Xie family was frugal, they wouldn’t stint on the old madam. The main reason was that after her illness, she had become somewhat afraid of the cold and preferred to stay warm.

"Staying at your maiden home for half a month, truly the first in our dynasty!" The old madam’s gaze was dark. "Outsiders might think that our Xie family has wronged you. And now, Jingyu’s official career is also going downhill. You really are a jinx!"

Madam Zhou stood to the side, not daring to interject.
